bar.en: Steel bars were installed across the museum windows to prevent thieves from entering after dark.
bar.zh: 博物馆窗户上安装了钢条，以防窃贼天黑后进入。

bud.en: In early spring, tiny green buds appear on the branches before the leaves fully unfold.
bud.zh: 早春时节，嫩绿的芽苞会在叶子完全展开之前出现在树枝上。

gem.en: The museum's collection includes a rare gem that was once owned by an ancient royal family.
gem.zh: 这家博物馆的藏品中有一颗珍贵的宝石，曾属于一个古代王室。

jar.en: Scientists sealed the soil sample in a glass jar to prevent contamination during transport.
jar.zh: 科学家把土壤样本密封在玻璃罐里，以防运输过程中受到污染。

jog.en: Doctors suggest that people jog for thirty minutes a day to improve heart health.
jog.zh: 医生建议人们每天慢跑三十分钟以改善心脏健康。

lag.en: Rural schools often lag behind urban ones in access to computers and high-speed internet.
lag.zh: 农村学校在获得电脑和高速网络方面往往落后于城市学校。

log.en: Researchers keep a detailed log of every experiment so that results can be checked later.
log.zh: 研究人员为每次实验做详细记录，以便日后核查结果。

ore.en: The country's economy depends heavily on exporting iron ore to industrial nations.
ore.zh: 该国经济严重依赖向工业国家出口铁矿石。

owl.en: The owl hunts silently at night, using its sharp hearing to locate small animals.
owl.zh: 猫头鹰在夜间悄无声息地捕猎，靠敏锐的听觉定位小动物。

sow.en: Farmers in this region sow their seeds in autumn so the crops can use winter rain.
sow.zh: 该地区的农民在秋季播种，好让作物利用冬季的雨水。

tag.en: Each item in the recycling bin carries a tag showing which materials can be processed.
tag.zh: 回收箱里的每件物品都贴有标签，标明哪些材料可以被处理。

wax.en: Historians believe the ancient letters were sealed with wax to protect their contents.
wax.zh: 历史学家认为这些古代信件用蜡封口以保护内容。

arid.en: Few crops can survive in such an arid climate, where rainfall is extremely rare.
arid.zh: 在如此干旱的气候中，降雨极为稀少，很少有作物能存活。

axis.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every twenty-four hours, causing day and night.
axis.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕地轴自转一周，从而产生昼夜。

bark.en: The dog began to bark loudly whenever strangers approached the farmhouse gate.
bark.zh: 每当陌生人走近农舍大门，那条狗就会大声吠叫。

barn.en: The old wooden barn now serves as a workshop where local artists display their work.
barn.zh: 这座旧木谷仓如今成了当地艺术家展示作品的工作室。

brim.en: She filled the cup to the brim with hot tea and carefully carried it to the table.
brim.zh: 她把杯子斟满热茶，小心地端到桌上。

bulb.en: Replacing traditional light bulbs with energy-saving ones can greatly reduce electricity consumption.
bulb.zh: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以大大降低电力消耗。

cell.en: The honeycomb is made up of thousands of hexagonal cells built by worker bees.
cell.zh: 蜂巢由工蜂建造的成千上万个六边形巢室组成。

cite.en: Students must cite all sources properly, or their essays may be rejected for plagiarism.
cite.zh: 学生必须正确引用所有资料来源，否则论文可能因抄袭而被拒。

clay.en: Ancient potters shaped clay into bowls and left them to dry in the sun.
clay.zh: 古代陶工把黏土捏成碗，然后放在阳光下晾干。

cone.en: The volcano's perfect cone shape attracts thousands of tourists to the island each year.
cone.zh: 这座火山完美的锥形每年吸引成千上万的游客来到该岛。

cram.en: Many students cram all night before exams instead of reviewing material gradually.
cram.zh: 许多学生在考试前通宵死记硬背，而不是循序渐进地复习。

damp.en: The basement felt cold and damp, so we bought a machine to remove the moisture.
damp.zh: 地下室又冷又潮湿，所以我们买了一台机器来除湿。

emit.en: Older vehicles emit far more harmful gases than modern electric cars do.
emit.zh: 老旧车辆排放的有害气体远远多于现代电动汽车。

epic.en: The film is an epic story of migration, spanning three generations across two continents.
epic.zh: 这部电影是一部跨越两大洲三代人的史诗般的迁徙故事。

even.en: The paint must be applied in an even layer, or the wall will look patchy.
even.zh: 涂料必须均匀地涂上一层，否则墙面会显得斑驳。

file.en: Please file these documents alphabetically so that they can be found quickly.
file.zh: 请按字母顺序把这些文件归档，以便快速查找。

flaw.en: The main flaw in the study is that it ignores the influence of family background.
flaw.zh: 这项研究的主要缺陷是忽略了家庭背景的影响。

flip.en: The teacher asked students to flip the card over and read the question on the back.
flip.zh: 老师让学生把卡片翻过来，读背面的问题。

gale.en: A strong gale swept across the coast, forcing fishing boats to return to harbor.
gale.zh: 一场强风席卷海岸，迫使渔船返回港口。

gear.en: The factory was reorganized to gear production toward environmentally friendly products.
gear.zh: 工厂进行了重组，使生产转向环保产品。

gene.en: Scientists have identified a gene that may increase the risk of certain heart diseases.
gene.zh: 科学家发现了一种可能增加某些心脏病风险的基因。

germ.en: Washing your hands frequently helps prevent the spread of germs in crowded places.
germ.zh: 勤洗手有助于防止细菌在拥挤场所传播。

gist.en: Although the article was long, the gist was that early education shapes later success.
gist.zh: 尽管这篇文章很长，但其主旨是早期教育塑造日后的成功。

gush.en: Oil began to gush from the broken pipe, threatening the nearby river.
gush.zh: 石油开始从破裂的管道中涌出，威胁到附近的河流。

hail.en: Residents were advised to stay indoors when hail the size of golf balls began falling.
hail.zh: 当高尔夫球大小的冰雹开始落下时，居民被建议留在室内。

hawk.en: The hawk circled high above the field, watching for any movement in the grass.
hawk.zh: 鹰在田野上空高高盘旋，留意着草丛中的任何动静。

herd.en: A herd of wild horses moved slowly across the valley in search of water.
herd.zh: 一群野马缓慢地穿过山谷寻找水源。

hike.en: The national park offers guided hikes that teach visitors about local plants and animals.
hike.zh: 国家公园提供有向导的徒步旅行，向游客介绍当地的动植物。

hive.en: The city center became a hive of activity as thousands of protesters gathered to demand stricter environmental laws.
hive.zh: 随着成千上万的抗议者聚集要求更严格的环境法律，市中心变成了一个繁忙的活动场所。

horn.en: The rhinoceros is hunted illegally for its horn, which some cultures mistakenly believe has medicinal value.
horn.zh: 犀牛因其角而被非法猎杀，一些文化错误地认为犀牛角具有药用价值。

idol.en: Many teenagers idolize pop stars and imitate their behavior, which worries some educators and parents.
idol.zh: 许多青少年崇拜流行歌星并模仿他们的行为，这令一些教育工作者和家长担忧。

mate.en: During the breeding season, male birds perform elaborate dances to attract a mate.
mate.zh: 在繁殖季节，雄鸟会表演精心的舞蹈来吸引配偶。

mean.en: The mean temperature in this region has risen by nearly two degrees over the past century.
mean.zh: 该地区的平均气温在过去一个世纪里上升了近两度。

mint.en: The government decided to mint a new series of coins to commemorate the country's cultural heritage.
mint.zh: 政府决定铸造一套新硬币以纪念该国的文化遗产。

mode.en: Online learning has become an increasingly popular mode of education, especially among working adults.
mode.zh: 在线学习已成为日益流行的教育模式，尤其是在在职成年人中。

peak.en: Air pollution levels often peak during the winter months when coal burning increases across northern cities.
peak.zh: 空气污染水平通常在冬季达到峰值，此时北方城市的燃煤量增加。

pine.en: Large areas of pine forest were destroyed by the wildfire that swept through the mountains last summer.
pine.zh: 去年夏天席卷山区的野火烧毁了大片松树林。

prey.en: The declining number of small mammals has forced predators to search for alternative prey.
prey.zh: 小型哺乳动物数量的下降迫使捕食者寻找替代猎物。

scan.en: Researchers scanned thousands of medical images to train an algorithm capable of detecting early tumors.
scan.zh: 研究人员扫描了数千张医学图像，以训练一种能够检测早期肿瘤的算法。

silt.en: The construction of the dam caused silt to accumulate downstream, damaging the river's ecosystem.
silt.zh: 大坝的修建导致泥沙在下游淤积，破坏了河流的生态系统。

skim.en: Students who merely skim the article before the exam often fail to grasp the author's central argument.
skim.zh: 考试前仅仅略读文章的学生往往无法理解作者的中心论点。

solo.en: The young pianist gave her first solo performance in front of an audience of over a thousand people.
solo.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在一千多名观众面前进行了她的首次独奏表演。

spur.en: Rising energy costs have spurred many households to invest in solar panels and energy-efficient appliances.
spur.zh: 能源成本上升促使许多家庭投资太阳能电池板和节能电器。

stem.en: Most researchers agree that the problem stems from a lack of investment in rural education.
stem.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，这个问题源于对农村教育投入不足。

thaw.en: The gradual thaw of Arctic permafrost releases large amounts of methane, accelerating global warming.
thaw.zh: 北极永久冻土的逐渐融化释放出大量甲烷，加速了全球变暖。

vent.en: Volcanic vents on the ocean floor release hot gases that support unique forms of marine life.
vent.zh: 海底的火山喷气口释放出热气体，支撑着独特的海洋生命形式。

weed.en: Farmers are experimenting with natural methods to control weeds without relying on harmful chemicals.
weed.zh: 农民们正在尝试用自然方法控制杂草，而不依赖有害化学物质。

abuse.en: The report revealed widespread abuse of antibiotics in livestock farming, contributing to drug resistance.
abuse.zh: 该报告揭示了畜牧业中抗生素的广泛滥用，导致了耐药性问题。

adapt.en: Some species can adapt quickly to changing environments, while others face extinction within decades.
adapt.zh: 有些物种能迅速适应变化的环境，而另一些则在几十年内面临灭绝。

adorn.en: The ancient temple was adorned with intricate carvings depicting scenes from local mythology.
adorn.zh: 这座古庙装饰着描绘当地神话场景的精致雕刻。

alter.en: Rising sea levels are likely to alter the coastlines of many low-lying island nations beyond recognition.
alter.zh: 海平面上升可能会使许多低洼岛国的海岸线变得面目全非。

amuse.en: Educational apps that amuse children while teaching them basic math skills have gained popularity among parents.
amuse.zh: 那些在教孩子基础数学的同时逗他们开心的教育应用程序在家长中越来越受欢迎。

audit.en: The company was required to conduct an independent audit of its carbon emissions before receiving certification.
audit.zh: 该公司在获得认证之前被要求对其碳排放进行独立审计。

breed.en: Scientists have managed to breed a variety of rice that can survive in salty soil.
breed.zh: 科学家们成功培育出一种能在盐碱土壤中存活的水稻品种。

carve.en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden panels that are sold to tourists worldwide.
carve.zh: 当地工匠在木板上雕刻传统图案，销往世界各地的游客。

choir.en: Joining the school choir helped the shy student build confidence and make new friends.
choir.zh: 加入学校唱诗班帮助这个害羞的学生建立了自信并结交了新朋友。

crack.en: A large crack appeared in the dam wall after the earthquake, forcing nearby residents to evacuate.
crack.zh: 地震后坝墙上出现了一条大裂缝，迫使附近居民撤离。

crust.en: The Earth's crust is divided into several tectonic plates that move slowly over millions of years.
crust.zh: 地壳被分为几个构造板块，它们在数百万年间缓慢移动。

delta.en: The fertile soil of the river delta supports intensive agriculture and a dense human population.
delta.zh: 河流三角洲的肥沃土壤支撑着集约化农业和稠密的人口。

draft.en: The committee released a draft of the new environmental policy for public consultation last week.
draft.zh: 委员会上周公布了新环境政策的草案，供公众咨询。

drain.en: Excessive irrigation has drained the underground water reserves faster than they can be replenished.
drain.zh: 过度灌溉使地下水资源枯竭的速度超过了其补充的速度。

elite.en: Access to elite universities remains heavily skewed toward students from wealthy urban families.
elite.zh: 进入精英大学的机会仍然严重偏向来自富裕城市家庭的学生。

erupt.en: The volcano erupted without warning, forcing authorities to evacuate thousands of people from nearby villages.
erupt.zh: 火山毫无预警地喷发，迫使当局从附近村庄疏散数千人。

fault.en: Critics pointed out several faults in the research design, including a small and unrepresentative sample.
fault.zh: 批评者指出了该研究设计中的几个缺陷，包括样本量小且不具代表性。

flock.en: Every autumn, huge flocks of migratory birds stop at this wetland to rest and feed.
flock.zh: 每年秋天，大批候鸟会在这个湿地停留休息和觅食。

flora.en: The island's unique flora has evolved in isolation for millions of years, producing many endemic species.
flora.zh: 该岛独特的植物群在隔离状态下进化了数百万年，产生了许多特有物种。

forge.en: The two universities agreed to forge a partnership aimed at advancing research in renewable energy.
forge.zh: 这两所大学同意建立合作伙伴关系，旨在推进可再生能源的研究。

gauge.en: It is difficult to gauge public opinion on the issue without conducting a large-scale survey.
gauge.zh: 如果不进行大规模调查，就很难判断公众对该问题的看法。

glide.en: The eagle glided silently over the valley, scanning the ground for signs of prey.
glide.zh: 老鹰无声地滑翔在山谷上空，扫视地面寻找猎物的踪迹。

grace.en: The ballet dancer moved across the stage with remarkable grace, captivating the entire audience.
grace.zh: 这位芭蕾舞者以非凡的优雅在舞台上移动，令全场观众着迷。

grant.en: The government granted the research team a substantial fund to develop a new water purification system.
grant.zh: 政府授予该研究团队一笔可观的资金，用于开发新的水净化系统。

hatch.en: Sea turtles return to the same beach where they were born to lay eggs that will hatch weeks later.
hatch.zh: 海龟回到它们出生的同一片海滩产卵，这些卵将在几周后孵化。

humid.en: The hot and humid climate of the tropical region makes it ideal for growing rice and tropical fruits.
humid.zh: 热带地区湿热的气候使其非常适合种植水稻和热带水果。

idiom.en: Learning idioms is essential for language learners who wish to understand everyday conversation among native speakers.
idiom.zh: 学习习语对于希望理解母语者日常对话的语言学习者来说至关重要。

inert.en: Noble gases are chemically inert, meaning they rarely react with other substances under normal conditions.
inert.zh: 稀有气体在化学上是惰性的，这意味着它们在正常条件下很少与其他物质发生反应。

infer.en: From the fossil evidence, scientists can infer that the species lived in a warm, humid environment.
infer.zh: 从化石证据中，科学家可以推断该物种生活在温暖潮湿的环境中。

issue.en: Climate change is no longer a distant threat but an urgent issue requiring immediate global action.
issue.zh: 气候变化不再是一个遥远的威胁，而是一个需要立即采取全球行动的紧迫问题。

ivory.en: The international ban on ivory trade aims to protect elephants from being killed for their tusks.
ivory.zh: 国际象牙贸易禁令旨在保护大象免遭为获取象牙而被杀害。

linen.en: In ancient Egypt, linen was the most common fabric used for clothing due to its lightness and durability.
linen.zh: 在古埃及，亚麻布因其轻盈耐用而成为最常用的服装面料。

lunar.en: The lunar surface is covered with craters formed by meteorite impacts over billions of years.
lunar.zh: 月球表面布满了数十亿年来陨石撞击形成的坑。

lyric.en: The poet's early works are highly lyric, expressing deep personal emotions through vivid imagery.
lyric.zh: 这位诗人的早期作品极具抒情性，通过生动的意象表达深切的个人情感。

mimic.en: Some birds can mimic human speech with surprising accuracy, which fascinates researchers studying animal cognition.
mimic.zh: 有些鸟类能以惊人的准确度模仿人类语言，这令研究动物认知的研究人员着迷。

oasis.en: The oasis in the middle of the desert provides water and shade for travelers and local wildlife.
oasis.zh: 沙漠中央的绿洲为旅行者和当地野生动物提供水源和阴凉。

pitch.en: The children pitched their tent near the lake and spent the evening watching the stars.
pitch.zh: 孩子们在湖边搭起了帐篷，傍晚时分观看星星。

pivot.en: The discussion began to pivot around the question of who should bear the cost of environmental cleanup.
pivot.zh: 讨论开始围绕谁应承担环境清理费用这一问题展开。

plain.en: Vast plains covered in grass stretch for hundreds of kilometers across the interior of the continent.
plain.zh: 覆盖着草皮的广阔平原在大陆内陆延伸数百公里。

polar.en: Polar ice caps are melting at an alarming rate due to rising global temperatures.
polar.zh: 由于全球气温上升，极地冰盖正以惊人的速度融化。

press.en: The press played a crucial role in exposing the corruption scandal that led to the minister's resignation.
press.zh: 新闻界在揭露导致部长辞职的腐败丑闻中发挥了关键作用。

probe.en: NASA launched a space probe to study the atmosphere of Jupiter and its numerous moons.
probe.zh: 美国宇航局发射了一个太空探测器来研究木星的大气层及其众多卫星。

query.en: The audience raised several queries about the reliability of the data presented in the lecture.
query.zh: 观众对讲座中所提供数据的可靠性提出了几个疑问。

quote.en: In her essay, she quoted a famous economist to support her argument about income inequality.
quote.zh: 在文章中，她引用了一位著名经济学家的话来支持她关于收入不平等的论点。

realm.en: Artificial intelligence is rapidly entering the realm of medical diagnosis, assisting doctors in detecting diseases.
realm.zh: 人工智能正迅速进入医学诊断领域，协助医生检测疾病。

ridge.en: The village sits on a narrow ridge overlooking the valley, protected from floods but exposed to strong winds.
ridge.zh: 这个村庄坐落在俯瞰山谷的狭窄山脊上，免受洪水侵袭但暴露在强风中。

rural.en: Many young people leave rural areas to seek better job opportunities in large cities.
rural.zh: 许多年轻人离开农村地区去大城市寻找更好的工作机会。

scale.en: The scale of the damage caused by the earthquake was far greater than initially estimated.
scale.zh: 地震造成的破坏规模远远超出最初的估计。

scarf.en: She wrapped a thick woolen scarf around her neck to protect herself from the biting wind.
scarf.zh: 她将一条厚厚的羊毛围巾裹在脖子上，以抵御刺骨的寒风。

score.en: Students who scored well on the standardized test were more likely to be admitted to top universities.
score.zh: 在标准化考试中得分高的学生更有可能被顶尖大学录取。

shear.en: Farmers use large shears to trim the hedges that separate their fields from the road.
shear.zh: 农民们使用大剪刀修剪将田地与道路隔开的树篱。

spawn.en: The documentary sparked a debate that spawned numerous research projects on the effects of social media.
spawn.zh: 这部纪录片引发了一场辩论，催生了许多关于社交媒体影响的研究项目。

spoil.en: The sudden power outage spoiled the food stored in the refrigerator, causing significant waste.
spoil.zh: 突然的停电使冰箱里储存的食物变质，造成了大量浪费。

stale.en: The bread had gone stale after being left uncovered on the counter overnight.
stale.zh: 面包在柜台上敞开放了一夜后变得不新鲜了。

steep.en: The steep slopes of the mountain make it difficult for farmers to cultivate crops.
steep.zh: 这座山陡峭的坡地使农民难以种植庄稼。

sting.en: The sting of a bee can cause severe allergic reactions in some people, requiring immediate medical attention.
sting.zh: 蜜蜂的蜇伤可能引起某些人严重的过敏反应，需要立即就医。

swamp.en: The swamp provides a vital habitat for frogs, insects, and numerous species of water birds.
swamp.zh: 沼泽为青蛙、昆虫和众多水鸟提供了重要的栖息地。

swarm.en: A swarm of locusts descended on the farmland, destroying crops across several villages within hours.
swarm.zh: 一大群蝗虫降临农田，在数小时内摧毁了几个村庄的庄稼。

thorn.en: Roses are beautiful but their thorns can cause painful injuries if handled carelessly.
thorn.zh: 玫瑰虽美，但如果处理不当，其刺会造成疼痛的伤害。

toxic.en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste into the river, contaminating the water supply.
toxic.zh: 该工厂因向河中倾倒有毒废物、污染水源而被罚款。

trend.en: There is a growing trend toward remote work, which is reshaping urban housing markets worldwide.
trend.zh: 远程工作的趋势日益增长，正在重塑全球城市住房市场。

tutor.en: The university assigns a personal tutor to each student to provide academic guidance and support.
tutor.zh: 大学为每位学生分配一名个人导师，提供学术指导和支持。

virus.en: Scientists are racing to develop a vaccine against the newly discovered virus before it spreads further.
virus.zh: 科学家们正争分夺秒地开发针对新发现病毒的疫苗，以防其进一步传播。

vogue.en: Plant-based diets have come into vogue as more people become aware of their environmental impact.
vogue.zh: 随着越来越多的人意识到其环境影响，植物性饮食开始流行。

absorb.en: Forests absorb enormous amounts of carbon dioxide, making them essential in the fight against climate change.
absorb.zh: 森林吸收大量二氧化碳，使其在应对气候变化中至关重要。

adjust.en: Farmers in the region have had to adjust their planting schedules in response to shifting rainfall patterns.
adjust.zh: 该地区的农民不得不调整种植时间表以应对降雨模式的变化。

arable.en: Only a small percentage of the country's land is arable, which limits its agricultural output.
arable.zh: 该国只有一小部分土地适合耕种，这限制了其农业产量。

aspect.en: One important aspect of urban planning is ensuring that public spaces are accessible to all residents.
aspect.zh: 城市规划的一个重要方面是确保公共空间对所有居民都可及。

assess.en: Researchers are trying to assess the long-term impact of screen time on children's cognitive development.
assess.zh: 研究人员正试图评估屏幕时间对儿童认知发展的长期影响。

assume.en: Many policymakers assume that economic growth will automatically reduce poverty, but the evidence is mixed.
assume.zh: 许多政策制定者假定经济增长会自动减少贫困，但证据并不一致。

attach.en: Some parents attach tracking devices to their children's bags to monitor their whereabouts.
attach.zh: 一些家长在孩子书包上安装追踪设备以监控他们的行踪。

attain.en: Few developing countries have managed to attain the level of industrial efficiency seen in Western Europe.
attain.zh: 很少有发展中国家能够达到西欧那样的工业效率水平。

barren.en: Decades of intensive farming left the once fertile hillside barren and unable to support any crops.
barren.zh: 几十年的集约耕作使曾经肥沃的山坡变得贫瘠，无法再种植任何作物。

botany.en: Her early interest in botany led her to document hundreds of plant species in the rainforest.
botany.zh: 她对植物学的早期兴趣促使她记录了雨林中的数百种植物。

canvas.en: The artist stretched a large canvas across the frame before beginning his portrait of the village.
canvas.zh: 画家在开始画村庄肖像之前，把一块大画布绷在画框上。

clause.en: The contract contains a clause requiring both parties to resolve disputes through arbitration.
clause.zh: 合同中有一项条款要求双方通过仲裁解决争议。

cosmos.en: Astronomers continue to debate how the earliest galaxies formed in the vast cosmos.
cosmos.zh: 天文学家仍在争论最早的星系是如何在浩瀚宇宙中形成的。

crater.en: The meteorite left a massive crater in the desert that scientists now study for clues.
crater.zh: 那颗陨石在沙漠中留下了一个巨大的坑，科学家们正在研究它寻找线索。

credit.en: Students must complete 120 credits before they can graduate with a bachelor's degree.
credit.zh: 学生必须修满120个学分才能获得学士学位毕业。

critic.en: The film critic praised the director for tackling social inequality with unusual sensitivity.
critic.zh: 这位影评人赞扬导演以非凡的敏感度处理了社会不平等问题。

debate.en: The debate over whether to ban single-use plastics has divided the local community.
debate.zh: 关于是否禁止一次性塑料制品的辩论使当地社区产生了分歧。

debris.en: Rescue workers searched the debris for survivors after the earthquake struck the coastal town.
debris.zh: 地震袭击这座沿海城镇后，救援人员在废墟中搜寻生还者。

decent.en: Many families in the region still lack decent housing and access to clean drinking water.
decent.zh: 该地区的许多家庭仍然缺乏像样的住房和清洁饮用水。

depict.en: The novel depicts rural life in the nineteenth century with remarkable historical accuracy.
depict.zh: 这部小说以惊人的历史准确性描绘了十九世纪的乡村生活。

desert.en: Rising temperatures could cause fertile land to desertify and eventually become desert.
desert.zh: 气温上升可能导致肥沃的土地荒漠化，最终变成沙漠。

devise.en: Engineers devised a new system to reduce energy consumption in large office buildings.
devise.zh: 工程师们设计了一套新系统来降低大型办公楼的能耗。

devour.en: Hungry caterpillars can devour an entire field of crops within a few days.
devour.zh: 饥饿的毛虫能在几天内吞食掉整片田地的庄稼。

dilute.en: Factories should not dilute chemical waste before releasing it into the river.
dilute.zh: 工厂不应在将化学废料排入河流之前对其进行稀释。

domain.en: Genetic engineering has moved beyond the domain of science fiction into everyday agriculture.
domain.zh: 基因工程已经超越了科幻小说的领域，进入了日常农业。

elicit.en: The researcher used open-ended questions to elicit detailed responses from the interviewees.
elicit.zh: 研究人员使用开放式问题来引出受访者的详细回答。

enzyme.en: This enzyme helps break down starch into simpler sugars during the digestion process.
enzyme.zh: 这种酶在消化过程中帮助将淀粉分解成更简单的糖。

evolve.en: Languages evolve over centuries as speakers borrow words and adapt to new technologies.
evolve.zh: 语言随着使用者借用词汇和适应新技术而历经数百年演变。

exceed.en: Air pollution levels in the city regularly exceed the limits recommended by health agencies.
exceed.zh: 该市的空气污染水平经常超过卫生机构建议的限值。

exotic.en: The garden showcases exotic plants imported from tropical regions around the world.
exotic.zh: 这座花园展示了从世界各地热带地区进口的外来植物。

fabric.en: The museum displays silk fabric traded along the ancient routes connecting Asia and Europe.
fabric.zh: 博物馆展出了沿连接亚欧的古代路线交易的丝绸织物。

filter.en: These plants filter harmful chemicals from the water before it reaches the lake.
filter.zh: 这些植物在水到达湖泊之前过滤掉其中的有害化学物质。

frigid.en: Few animals can survive the frigid temperatures of the Antarctic interior during winter.
frigid.zh: 很少有动物能在冬季南极内陆的严寒中生存。

galaxy.en: Our galaxy contains billions of stars, many of which may host their own planetary systems.
galaxy.zh: 我们的星系包含数十亿颗恒星，其中许多可能拥有自己的行星系统。

handle.en: Teachers must learn to handle disruptive behaviour without losing control of the classroom.
handle.zh: 教师必须学会处理扰乱行为而不失去对课堂的控制。

hurdle.en: Lack of funding remains the biggest hurdle facing young scientists seeking to conduct research.
hurdle.zh: 缺乏资金仍然是年轻科学家开展研究面临的最大障碍。

impact.en: The new policy had a significant impact on rural employment and household income.
impact.zh: 新政策对农村就业和家庭收入产生了重大影响。

linger.en: Concerns about data privacy continue to linger despite the company's promises of reform.
linger.zh: 尽管该公司承诺改革，对数据隐私的担忧仍然挥之不去。

liquid.en: Water is the only substance on Earth that exists naturally as a solid, liquid and gas.
liquid.zh: 水是地球上唯一以固体、液体和气体形式自然存在的物质。

litter.en: Volunteers collected tonnes of litter from the beach after the summer festival.
litter.zh: 夏季音乐节结束后，志愿者从海滩上收集了数吨垃圾。

lumber.en: The country exports large quantities of lumber to meet growing demand for construction materials.
lumber.zh: 该国出口大量木材以满足对建筑材料日益增长的需求。

luxury.en: For many rural families, a private car remains an unaffordable luxury.
luxury.zh: 对许多农村家庭来说，私家车仍然是负担不起的奢侈品。

mammal.en: The blue whale is the largest mammal ever to have lived on Earth.
mammal.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上曾经生活过的最大哺乳动物。

mantle.en: Scientists study the Earth's mantle to understand how volcanoes and earthquakes occur.
mantle.zh: 科学家研究地幔以了解火山和地震是如何发生的。

marble.en: The ancient temple was built from white marble imported from distant quarries.
marble.zh: 这座古庙是用从远处采石场运来的白色大理石建造的。

margin.en: The candidate won the election by a narrow margin of just two hundred votes.
margin.zh: 这位候选人以仅两百票的微弱优势赢得了选举。

marine.en: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine ecosystems across the world's oceans.
marine.zh: 塑料垃圾对全球海洋的海洋生态系统构成严重威胁。

mature.en: Children mature at different rates, so comparing them by age alone can be misleading.
mature.zh: 儿童成熟的速度各不相同，因此仅按年龄比较他们可能会产生误导。

medium.en: Television remains a powerful medium for shaping public opinion in many countries.
medium.zh: 电视在许多国家仍然是塑造公众舆论的有力媒介。

melody.en: The simple melody of the folk song has been passed down through generations.
melody.zh: 这首民歌简单的旋律代代相传。

mobile.en: Mobile technology has transformed the way farmers access market prices and weather forecasts.
mobile.zh: 移动技术改变了农民获取市场价格和天气预报的方式。

novice.en: Even a novice can learn to identify common birds with the help of a good guide.
novice.zh: 即使是一个新手，在良好指南的帮助下也能学会识别常见的鸟类。

patent.en: The company filed a patent for its new battery design to protect its commercial interests.
patent.zh: 该公司为其新电池设计申请了专利以保护其商业利益。

perish.en: Thousands of crops perished during the drought, leaving farmers without any income.
perish.zh: 成千上万的庄稼在干旱中枯死，使农民失去了任何收入。

plunge.en: Temperatures are expected to plunge below freezing across the northern region tonight.
plunge.zh: 预计今晚北部地区的气温将骤降至冰点以下。

pollen.en: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another, helping plants reproduce.
pollen.zh: 蜜蜂将花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花，帮助植物繁殖。

radius.en: Residents within a ten-kilometre radius of the plant were evacuated as a precaution.
radius.zh: 作为预防措施，工厂十公里半径内的居民被疏散。

revise.en: The committee decided to revise the proposal after receiving feedback from local residents.
revise.zh: 委员会在收到当地居民的反馈后决定修改该提案。

reward.en: The government offers a financial reward to anyone who reports illegal logging activities.
reward.zh: 政府向任何举报非法伐木活动的人提供经济奖励。

riddle.en: How ancient people built such massive structures without modern machinery remains a riddle.
riddle.zh: 古人在没有现代机械的情况下如何建造如此巨大的建筑仍然是个谜。

ritual.en: The tea ceremony is an important ritual that reflects the values of the culture.
ritual.zh: 茶道是一种重要的仪式，反映了该文化的价值观。

sacred.en: The mountain is considered sacred by local communities and attracts thousands of pilgrims.
sacred.zh: 这座山被当地社区视为神圣之地，吸引了成千上万的朝圣者。

saddle.en: Riders should adjust the saddle carefully to prevent injury to the horse's back.
saddle.zh: 骑手应仔细调整马鞍，以防伤害马的背部。

scheme.en: The government launched a recycling scheme to reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills.
scheme.zh: 政府启动了一项回收计划，以减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

screen.en: Children should not spend more than two hours a day in front of a screen.
screen.zh: 儿童每天在屏幕前的时间不应超过两小时。

signal.en: The phone signal in remote mountain villages is often too weak to make calls.
signal.zh: 偏远山村中的手机信号往往太弱，无法拨打电话。

sprawl.en: Rapid urban sprawl has swallowed up valuable farmland around major cities.
sprawl.zh: 快速的城市蔓延已经吞没了大城市周围宝贵的农田。

squash.en: The mother accidentally squashed the insect while cleaning the kitchen table.
squash.zh: 母亲在擦厨房桌子时不小心把昆虫压扁了。

staple.en: Rice is the staple food for more than half of the world's population.
staple.zh: 大米是世界上超过一半人口的主食。

static.en: Unlike a photograph, a painting is not a static image but a record of movement.
static.zh: 与照片不同，绘画不是静态的图像，而是运动的记录。

status.en: In many societies, teachers no longer enjoy the high social status they once had.
status.zh: 在许多社会中，教师不再享有他们曾经拥有的高社会地位。

strand.en: A single strand of DNA carries the genetic instructions necessary for life.
strand.zh: 一条DNA链携带着生命所必需的遗传指令。

stream.en: Waste from the factory flowed directly into the stream, killing most of the fish.
stream.zh: 工厂的废料直接流入小溪，杀死了大部分鱼类。

stride.en: The country has made great strides in reducing child mortality over the past decade.
stride.zh: 过去十年，该国在降低儿童死亡率方面取得了巨大进步。

submit.en: Students must submit their essays by Friday or face a penalty for lateness.
submit.zh: 学生必须在周五之前提交论文，否则将面临迟交处罚。

thesis.en: Her doctoral thesis examines the relationship between social media and political participation.
thesis.zh: 她的博士论文探讨了社交媒体与政治参与之间的关系。

thrive.en: Small businesses thrive when local governments reduce taxes and simplify regulations.
thrive.zh: 当地方政府减税并简化法规时，小企业就会蓬勃发展。

throng.en: A throng of tourists gathered in the square to watch the traditional dance performance.
throng.zh: 一大群游客聚集在广场上观看传统舞蹈表演。

timber.en: Illegal logging threatens the country's tropical forests and the timber trade they support.
timber.zh: 非法伐木威胁着该国的热带森林及其支撑的木材贸易。

tissue.en: The disease gradually destroys muscle tissue, leaving patients weak and unable to walk.
tissue.zh: 这种疾病逐渐破坏肌肉组织，使患者虚弱无法行走。

verbal.en: Strong verbal communication skills are essential for success in most professional careers.
verbal.zh: 出色的口头沟通能力对大多数职业生涯的成功至关重要。

wither.en: Without regular rainfall, the young saplings will wither and die within weeks.
wither.zh: 如果没有定期降雨，这些幼树苗将在几周内枯萎死亡。

analogy.en: The teacher used the analogy of a computer to explain how the human brain works.
analogy.zh: 老师用计算机的类比来解释人脑是如何工作的。

antique.en: The antique vase, dating back three centuries, was sold at auction for a fortune.
antique.zh: 这只可追溯到三个世纪前的古董花瓶在拍卖会上以巨款售出。

barrier.en: Language remains a major barrier for immigrants seeking employment in their new country.
barrier.zh: 语言仍然是移民在新国家求职的主要障碍。

blossom.en: The cherry trees blossom every spring, attracting visitors from across the country.
blossom.zh: 樱花树每年春天开花，吸引着来自全国各地的游客。

burgeon.en: The renewable energy industry has burgeoned in recent years thanks to government subsidies.
burgeon.zh: 近年来，得益于政府补贴，可再生能源产业迅速发展。

circuit.en: A single faulty circuit can cause the entire electrical system to shut down.
circuit.zh: 一个故障电路就能导致整个电力系统关闭。

compile.en: The team spent five years compiling data on air quality across major cities.
compile.zh: 该团队花了五年时间汇编主要城市的空气质量数据。

compose.en: Hydrogen and oxygen compose water, the most abundant compound on Earth's surface.
compose.zh: 氢和氧构成水，这是地球表面最丰富的化合物。

confirm.en: Further experiments are needed to confirm whether the drug is safe for human use.
confirm.zh: 需要进一步的实验来确认该药物是否可安全用于人类。

content.en: The content of the course covers both theoretical concepts and practical applications.
content.zh: 该课程的内容涵盖理论概念和实践应用。

context.en: Words often change meaning depending on the context in which they are used.
context.zh: 词语的含义往往随使用语境的变化而变化。

convert.en: The old factory was converted into an art gallery that now attracts thousands of visitors.
convert.zh: 这座旧工厂被改造成一座美术馆，如今吸引着成千上万的游客。

costume.en: The actors wore traditional costumes that reflected the fashion of the eighteenth century.
costume.zh: 演员们穿着反映十八世纪时尚的传统服装。

cushion.en: The seats were fitted with soft cushions to make the long journey more comfortable.
cushion.zh: 座位上装有柔软的软垫，使长途旅行更加舒适。

diagram.en: The diagram shows how water circulates through the atmosphere, oceans and land.
diagram.zh: 该图显示了水如何在大气、海洋和陆地之间循环。

dialect.en: Young people increasingly abandon local dialects in favour of the standard national language.
dialect.zh: 年轻人越来越多地放弃当地方言，转而使用标准国语。

dictate.en: Market forces should not be allowed to dictate the quality of public education.
dictate.zh: 不应让市场力量决定公共教育的质量。

discern.en: It is often difficult to discern the true motives behind a company's charitable donations.
discern.zh: 通常很难辨别一家公司慈善捐赠背后的真实动机。

distant.en: Many students feel distant from their families after moving to study in another city.
distant.zh: 许多学生在搬到另一个城市学习后感到与家人疏远。

diverse.en: The city is home to a diverse population speaking more than fifty different languages.
diverse.zh: 这座城市拥有多样化的人口，讲着五十多种不同的语言。

dormant.en: Some seeds remain dormant in the soil for years until conditions become favourable.
dormant.zh: 有些种子在土壤中休眠多年，直到条件变得有利。

drought.en: The severe drought forced the government to restrict water use across the region.
drought.zh: 严重的干旱迫使政府限制整个地区的用水。

eminent.en: The conference attracted eminent scientists from leading universities around the world.
eminent.zh: 这次会议吸引了来自世界顶尖大学的杰出科学家。

enhance.en: Regular exercise can enhance both physical health and mental well-being.
enhance.zh: 定期锻炼可以增强身体健康和心理健康。

equator.en: Countries near the equator experience warm temperatures throughout the entire year.
equator.zh: 赤道附近的国家全年气温温暖。

extract.en: Researchers were able to extract small amounts of DNA from the ancient bones buried beneath the cave floor.
extract.zh: 研究人员成功地从洞穴地面下埋葬的古老骨骼中提取出少量DNA。

faculty.en: The university's engineering faculty has introduced a new programme that combines robotics with environmental science.
faculty.zh: 这所大学的工程学院推出了一项将机器人技术与环境科学相结合的新课程。

fantasy.en: Many teenagers escape into online fantasy worlds where they can create identities entirely different from their own.
fantasy.zh: 许多青少年逃入网络幻想世界，在那里他们可以创造与自身完全不同的身份。

ferment.en: The mixture is left to ferment for several weeks, allowing beneficial bacteria to break down the sugars.
ferment.zh: 这种混合物要发酵数周，让有益细菌分解其中的糖分。

fertile.en: The fertile soil along the river valley supports intensive agriculture that feeds millions of people downstream.
fertile.zh: 河谷沿岸肥沃的土壤支撑着集约化农业，养活了下游数百万人。

fragile.en: The coral reef ecosystem is extremely fragile and can be damaged by even a slight rise in water temperature.
fragile.zh: 珊瑚礁生态系统极其脆弱，即使水温轻微上升也可能对其造成破坏。

granite.en: The monument was carved from a single block of granite that workers transported over two hundred kilometres.
granite.zh: 这座纪念碑由一整块花岗岩雕成，工人们将其运送了两百多公里。

gravity.en: Astronauts must exercise daily because the absence of gravity causes their muscles and bones to weaken rapidly.
gravity.zh: 宇航员必须每天锻炼，因为失重会使他们的肌肉和骨骼迅速衰弱。

habitat.en: Urban expansion has destroyed the natural habitat of many bird species, forcing them to migrate elsewhere.
habitat.zh: 城市扩张破坏了许多鸟类的自然栖息地，迫使它们迁徙到别处。

harness.en: Scientists are developing new technologies to harness solar energy more efficiently in regions with limited sunlight.
harness.zh: 科学家正在开发新技术，以便在日照有限的地区更高效地利用太阳能。

immense.en: The immense scale of the Amazon rainforest makes it essential to global climate regulation and biodiversity.
immense.zh: 亚马孙雨林规模巨大，对全球气候调节和生物多样性至关重要。

impetus.en: The government's new funding policy gave fresh impetus to research into renewable energy technologies.
impetus.zh: 政府新的资助政策为可再生能源技术研究注入了新的动力。

inherit.en: Children may inherit certain personality traits from their parents, though environment also plays a significant role.
inherit.zh: 儿童可能从父母那里继承某些性格特征，不过环境也起着重要作用。

license.en: Drivers must obtain a valid license before they are allowed to operate any vehicle on public roads.
license.zh: 司机必须获得有效驾照，才被允许在公共道路上驾驶任何车辆。

massive.en: The massive investment in public transport has significantly reduced traffic congestion in the city centre.
massive.zh: 对公共交通的大规模投资显著缓解了市中心的交通拥堵。

microbe.en: Certain microbes in the soil play a crucial role in breaking down organic matter and recycling nutrients.
microbe.zh: 土壤中的某些微生物在分解有机物和循环养分方面起着关键作用。

noxious.en: Factories released noxious gases into the atmosphere for years before regulations were finally introduced.
noxious.zh: 工厂多年来向大气排放有害气体，直到最终出台了相关法规。

obscure.en: The professor's explanation was so obscure that even his most advanced students struggled to follow it.
obscure.zh: 教授的讲解晦涩难懂，连他最优秀的学生也难以跟上。

outline.en: The report begins with a brief outline of the main arguments before examining each one in detail.
outline.zh: 报告开头先简要概述主要论点，然后逐一详细探讨。

overlap.en: The two research projects overlap in several areas, so the teams decided to share their data.
overlap.zh: 这两个研究项目在若干领域有重叠，因此团队决定共享数据。

pigment.en: The artist used natural pigments derived from plants and minerals to create the vivid colours in the painting.
pigment.zh: 这位艺术家使用从植物和矿物中提取的天然颜料，在画作中创造出鲜艳的色彩。

plaster.en: Workers applied a layer of plaster to the walls before painting them a light shade of blue.
plaster.zh: 工人们先在墙上涂了一层灰泥，然后刷上浅蓝色。

plateau.en: The Tibetan plateau is often called the roof of the world because of its extremely high elevation.
plateau.zh: 青藏高原因其海拔极高而常被称为世界屋脊。

precise.en: The precise measurement of the earthquake's magnitude allowed authorities to assess the damage accurately.
precise.zh: 对地震震级的精确测量使当局能够准确评估损失。

presume.en: We can presume that the ancient builders used simple tools, since no advanced machinery has been found at the site.
presume.zh: 我们可以假定古代建造者使用了简单工具，因为在遗址中未发现任何先进机械。

prevail.en: Despite widespread opposition, the belief that education should be free for all eventually prevailed.
prevail.zh: 尽管遭到广泛反对，教育应对所有人免费这一信念最终占了上风。

primate.en: The primate's ability to use simple tools suggests that problem-solving skills evolved earlier than previously thought.
primate.zh: 这种灵长类动物使用简单工具的能力表明，解决问题的能力比先前认为的进化得更早。

profile.en: The magazine published a detailed profile of the scientist whose research transformed modern medicine.
profile.zh: 这本杂志刊登了一篇关于这位科学家的详细人物简介，他的研究改变了现代医学。

recruit.en: The company plans to recruit fifty graduates this year to expand its research and development department.
recruit.zh: 该公司计划今年招聘五十名毕业生，以扩充其研发部门。

release.en: The government decided to release the environmental report only after months of internal debate.
release.zh: 经过数月内部辩论，政府才决定发布这份环境报告。

secrete.en: Certain glands in the human body secrete hormones that regulate growth, mood, and metabolism.
secrete.zh: 人体中的某些腺体分泌调节生长、情绪和新陈代谢的激素。

seismic.en: Seismic activity in the region has increased sharply, prompting scientists to install additional monitoring equipment.
seismic.zh: 该地区的地震活动急剧增加，促使科学家安装更多监测设备。

stretch.en: The desert stretches for hundreds of kilometres, making it one of the largest arid regions on Earth.
stretch.zh: 这片沙漠绵延数百公里，是地球上最大的干旱地区之一。

subject.en: Each subject in the experiment was asked to complete a series of memory tests under controlled conditions.
subject.zh: 实验中的每个受试者都被要求在受控条件下完成一系列记忆测试。

summary.en: At the end of the article, the author provides a brief summary of the key findings and their implications.
summary.zh: 文章末尾，作者简要总结了主要发现及其意义。

swallow.en: The swallow migrates thousands of kilometres each year, travelling from Europe to southern Africa.
swallow.zh: 燕子每年迁徙数千公里，从欧洲飞到非洲南部。

terrain.en: The mountainous terrain made it difficult for rescue teams to reach the isolated village after the landslide.
terrain.zh: 山地在滑坡后使救援队难以抵达这个与世隔绝的村庄。

tornado.en: A powerful tornado swept through the town, destroying dozens of homes within a matter of minutes.
tornado.zh: 一场强烈的龙卷风席卷了这座小镇，几分钟内摧毁了数十座房屋。

torrent.en: Heavy rainfall turned the quiet stream into a raging torrent that swept away everything in its path.
torrent.zh: 暴雨将平静的小溪变成了汹涌的激流，冲走了沿途的一切。

tragedy.en: The tragedy highlighted the urgent need for stricter safety regulations in the mining industry.
tragedy.zh: 这场悲剧凸显了采矿业迫切需要更严格的安全法规。

uniform.en: The school requires all students to wear a uniform, which some parents believe reduces social inequality.
uniform.zh: 学校要求所有学生穿校服，一些家长认为这能减少社会不平等。

abstract.en: Before reading the full paper, participants were asked to summarise the abstract in their own words.
abstract.zh: 在阅读全文之前，参与者被要求用自己的话概括摘要。

accurate.en: Accurate weather forecasting depends on collecting reliable data from thousands of monitoring stations worldwide.
accurate.zh: 准确的天气预报依赖于从全球数千个监测站收集可靠数据。

acoustic.en: The concert hall was designed with special acoustic panels to ensure that every seat enjoys perfect sound quality.
acoustic.zh: 音乐厅采用了特殊的声学面板设计，确保每个座位都能享受完美的音质。

adjacent.en: The new library was built on a plot adjacent to the science building, making it convenient for students.
adjacent.zh: 新图书馆建在紧邻科学楼的一块地上，方便了学生。

ancestor.en: DNA analysis revealed that the modern horse's ancestor was a much smaller animal that lived millions of years ago.
ancestor.zh: DNA分析显示，现代马的祖先是一种生活在数百万年前的体型小得多的动物。

anecdote.en: The lecturer opened with a humorous anecdote about his first day as a university student.
anecdote.zh: 讲师以一则关于他大学第一天趣事的幽默轶事开场。

aptitude.en: Children who show an early aptitude for mathematics should be given extra support to develop their potential.
aptitude.zh: 早期表现出数学天赋的儿童应获得额外支持以发展其潜能。

artifact.en: Archaeologists discovered several clay artifacts that offer valuable clues about daily life in ancient times.
artifact.zh: 考古学家发现了几件陶制手工艺品，为研究古代日常生活提供了宝贵线索。

assemble.en: Hundreds of protesters assembled outside the parliament building to demand stronger environmental protection laws.
assemble.zh: 数百名抗议者聚集在议会大楼外，要求出台更严格的环境保护法。

brochure.en: The travel agency produced a colourful brochure describing the cultural attractions of the region.
brochure.zh: 旅行社制作了一本色彩鲜艳的小册子，介绍该地区的文化景点。

calamity.en: The flood was the worst calamity to strike the region in over fifty years, displacing thousands of families.
calamity.zh: 这场洪水是该地区五十多年来遭遇的最严重灾难，使数千个家庭流离失所。

calculus.en: Students who wish to study engineering must first complete courses in calculus and physics.
calculus.zh: 希望学习工程学的学生必须先修完微积分和物理课程。

catalyst.en: The discovery of penicillin acted as a catalyst for the development of modern antibiotics.
catalyst.zh: 青霉素的发现成为现代抗生素发展的催化剂。

category.en: The books in the library are divided into categories such as history, science, and literature.
category.zh: 图书馆的书籍被分为历史、科学和文学等类别。

ceremony.en: The graduation ceremony was held outdoors, with hundreds of families gathering to celebrate the occasion.
ceremony.zh: 毕业典礼在户外举行，数百个家庭聚集在一起庆祝这一时刻。

champion.en: She has long championed the rights of indigenous communities to protect their traditional lands.
champion.zh: 她长期支持原住民社区保护其传统土地的权利。

classify.en: Scientists classify organisms into groups based on their genetic similarities and evolutionary relationships.
classify.zh: 科学家根据遗传相似性和进化关系将生物分类。

compound.en: The chemical compound was found to be effective at killing bacteria without harming human cells.
compound.zh: 这种化合物被发现能有效杀灭细菌而不损害人体细胞。

compress.en: The software can compress large video files into smaller formats without significant loss of quality.
compress.zh: 该软件可以将大型视频文件压缩成较小的格式，而不会明显降低质量。

condense.en: The author was asked to condense her three-hundred-page thesis into a short article for publication.
condense.zh: 作者被要求将她三百页的论文精简成一篇短文以供发表。

contrast.en: The contrast between urban and rural living standards remains a major concern for policymakers.
contrast.zh: 城乡生活水平之间的差距仍是政策制定者关注的主要问题。

decipher.en: Scholars spent decades trying to decipher the symbols carved into the ancient stone tablet.
decipher.zh: 学者们花了数十年试图破译刻在古老石碑上的符号。

decorate.en: Local artists were invited to decorate the walls of the community centre with colourful murals.
decorate.zh: 当地艺术家受邀用色彩鲜艳的壁画装饰社区中心的墙壁。

demolish.en: The city council decided to demolish the old stadium and build a modern sports complex in its place.
demolish.zh: 市议会决定拆除旧体育场，并在原址建造一座现代化的体育中心。

desolate.en: After the mining company left, the once-thriving town became a desolate place with empty streets.
desolate.zh: 矿业公司离开后，这个曾经繁荣的小镇变成了街道空荡的荒凉之地。

diagnose.en: Doctors can now diagnose certain genetic disorders before a baby is even born.
diagnose.zh: 医生现在甚至可以在婴儿出生前诊断出某些遗传疾病。

diagonal.en: The architect drew a diagonal line across the square to divide it into two triangular sections.
diagonal.zh: 建筑师在正方形上画了一条对角线，将其分成两个三角形区域。

diameter.en: The telescope's mirror has a diameter of ten metres, making it one of the largest in the world.
diameter.zh: 这台望远镜的镜面直径达十米，是世界上最大的之一。

disaster.en: The oil spill was an environmental disaster that killed thousands of seabirds and marine mammals.
disaster.zh: 这次石油泄漏是一场环境灾难，导致数千只海鸟和海洋哺乳动物死亡。

displace.en: Rising sea levels could displace millions of people living in low-lying coastal areas.
displace.zh: 海平面上升可能使数百万生活在低洼沿海地区的人流离失所。

dissolve.en: Stir the powder into warm water until it dissolves completely and the liquid becomes clear.
dissolve.zh: 将粉末搅拌到温水中，直到它完全溶解，液体变得清澈。

distinct.en: The two species look similar but have distinct feeding habits that reduce competition between them.
distinct.zh: 这两个物种看起来相似，但有不同的摄食习性，从而减少了它们之间的竞争。

doctrine.en: The legal doctrine of free speech has been interpreted differently by courts over the years.
doctrine.zh: 多年来，法院对言论自由这一法律原则作出了不同的解释。

epidemic.en: The government launched a nationwide campaign to prevent the spread of the flu epidemic.
epidemic.zh: 政府发起了一场全国性运动，以防止流感疫情的蔓延。

equation.en: Balancing the chemical equation requires adding the correct coefficients to each side.
equation.zh: 配平化学方程式需要在两边加上正确的系数。

excavate.en: Archaeologists plan to excavate the site next summer in the hope of finding more ancient pottery.
excavate.zh: 考古学家计划明年夏天发掘该遗址，希望能找到更多古代陶器。

exponent.en: She is a leading exponent of the view that technology should serve human needs rather than replace them.
exponent.zh: 她是技术应服务于人类需求而非取代人类这一观点的主要倡导者。

flexible.en: Employers increasingly offer flexible working hours so that staff can balance career and family life.
flexible.zh: 雇主越来越多地提供灵活的工作时间，以便员工平衡事业和家庭生活。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the plastic produced each year is actually recycled.
fraction.zh: 每年生产的塑料中只有一小部分被真正回收利用。

fragment.en: The explosion shattered the glass into tiny fragments that covered the entire street.
fragment.zh: 爆炸将玻璃震成细小的碎片，铺满了整条街道。

friction.en: Engineers are trying to reduce friction between moving parts to improve the engine's efficiency.
friction.zh: 工程师正试图减少运动部件之间的摩擦，以提高发动机的效率。

genetics.en: Advances in genetics have made it possible to identify the causes of many inherited diseases.
genetics.zh: 遗传学的进步使识别许多遗传性疾病的病因成为可能。

ideology.en: The political ideology of the ruling party shaped nearly every aspect of national policy.
ideology.zh: 执政党的政治意识形态几乎影响了国家政策的方方面面。

inferior.en: Consumers often assume that cheaper products are of inferior quality, but this is not always true.
inferior.zh: 消费者常认为便宜的产品质量较差，但这并不总是正确的。

infringe.en: The new surveillance law may infringe on citizens' right to privacy, according to human rights groups.
infringe.zh: 人权组织认为，新的监控法可能侵犯公民的隐私权。

latitude.en: The latitude of a location determines the length of its days and the angle of the sun.
latitude.zh: 一个地点的纬度决定了其白昼的长短和太阳的角度。

manifest.en: The symptoms of the disease usually manifest themselves several weeks after infection.
manifest.zh: 这种疾病的症状通常在感染数周后才显现出来。

molecule.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子与一个氧原子结合而成。

mosquito.en: The mosquito is capable of transmitting dangerous diseases such as malaria and dengue fever.
mosquito.zh: 蚊子能够传播疟疾和登革热等危险疾病。

multiple.en: The study found that children exposed to multiple languages tend to develop stronger cognitive skills.
multiple.zh: 研究发现，接触多种语言的儿童往往具有更强的认知能力。

multiply.en: Bacteria multiply rapidly in warm, moist conditions, which is why food spoils quickly in summer.
multiply.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的条件下迅速繁殖，这就是食物在夏天容易变质的原因。

nutrient.en: Nitrogen and phosphorus from farm runoff are key nutrients that can trigger excessive algae growth in rivers and lakes.
nutrient.zh: 农田径流中的氮和磷是关键的营养物质，会导致河流和湖泊中藻类过度生长。

organism.en: Some deep-sea organisms survive without sunlight by deriving energy from chemicals released by volcanic vents.
organism.zh: 一些深海生物不依赖阳光，而是通过从火山口释放的化学物质中获取能量来生存。

overlook.en: Policymakers often overlook the needs of rural communities when designing national healthcare programmes.
overlook.zh: 政策制定者在设计国家医疗方案时常常忽视农村社区的需求。

pamphlet.en: The museum distributes a free pamphlet that explains the history of each major exhibit.
pamphlet.zh: 博物馆免费发放一本小册子，介绍每件主要展品的历史。

parallel.en: The two countries followed parallel paths of industrial development despite very different political systems.
parallel.zh: 尽管政治制度截然不同，这两个国家却走了平行的工业发展道路。

parasite.en: The parasite lives inside the host's digestive system and absorbs nutrients from its food.
parasite.zh: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的消化系统内，从其食物中吸收营养。

pinpoint.en: Scientists used satellite data to pinpoint the exact location of the melting glacier.
pinpoint.zh: 科学家利用卫星数据精确定位了融化冰川的位置。

portable.en: Portable solar panels allow hikers to charge their devices even in remote mountain areas.
portable.zh: 便携式太阳能板让徒步者即使在偏远山区也能为设备充电。

predator.en: Wolves are apex predators that help maintain balance in the forest ecosystem by controlling deer numbers.
predator.zh: 狼是顶级捕食者，通过控制鹿的数量帮助维持森林生态系统的平衡。

prestige.en: The university has gained international prestige for its pioneering research in renewable energy.
prestige.zh: 这所大学因其在可再生能源领域的开创性研究而获得国际声望。

profound.en: The invention of the printing press had a profound impact on the spread of knowledge across Europe.
profound.zh: 印刷机的发明对知识在欧洲的传播产生了深远的影响。

rational.en: Consumers are not always rational; emotional factors often influence their purchasing decisions more than price.
rational.zh: 消费者并不总是理性的；情感因素往往比价格更能影响他们的购买决策。

religion.en: Throughout history, religion has shaped art, architecture and social values in many civilizations.
religion.zh: 纵观历史，宗教塑造了许多文明的艺术、建筑和社会价值观。

sediment.en: Layers of sediment at the bottom of the lake record thousands of years of climate change.
sediment.zh: 湖底的沉积物层记录了数千年的气候变化。

simulate.en: Engineers use computer models to simulate how bridges will behave during earthquakes.
simulate.zh: 工程师利用计算机模型模拟桥梁在地震中的表现。

souvenir.en: Tourists often buy local handicrafts as souvenirs to remember their trip.
souvenir.zh: 游客常常购买当地手工艺品作为纪念品来记住他们的旅行。

specimen.en: The biologist collected a rare plant specimen and carefully preserved it for further study.
specimen.zh: 生物学家采集了一株稀有植物标本，并小心保存以供进一步研究。

spectrum.en: The survey revealed a wide spectrum of opinions on how to reform the education system.
spectrum.zh: 调查显示，人们对如何改革教育制度有着广泛多样的意见。

squirrel.en: A squirrel buried acorns in the garden, helping to spread oak trees across the neighbourhood.
squirrel.zh: 一只松鼠把橡子埋在花园里，帮助橡树在整个社区传播。

symphony.en: The city orchestra performed a symphony by Beethoven to a sold-out concert hall.
symphony.zh: 市管弦乐团在座无虚席的音乐厅演奏了贝多芬的一部交响乐。

vertical.en: The cliff rises in an almost vertical line from the sea to a height of two hundred metres.
vertical.zh: 悬崖从海面几乎垂直升起，高达两百米。

vigorous.en: Vigorous debate among scientists eventually led to a better understanding of climate change.
vigorous.zh: 科学家之间激烈的辩论最终促成了对气候变化更好的理解。

accessory.en: The phone comes with several accessories, including a charger, earphones and a protective case.
accessory.zh: 这款手机配有几个配件，包括充电器、耳机和保护壳。

aesthetic.en: The architect combined functional design with aesthetic appeal to create a building that is both practical and beautiful.
aesthetic.zh: 建筑师将功能设计与审美吸引力相结合，打造出既实用又美观的建筑。

aggravate.en: Cutting down forests can aggravate flooding because trees normally absorb large amounts of rainwater.
aggravate.zh: 砍伐森林会加剧洪水，因为树木通常能吸收大量雨水。

alternate.en: Farmers often alternate crops between seasons to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests.
alternate.zh: 农民常常在不同季节轮种作物，以保持土壤肥力并减少病虫害。

animation.en: The film uses computer animation to bring extinct dinosaurs back to life on screen.
animation.zh: 这部电影运用电脑动画让已灭绝的恐龙在银幕上复活。

available.en: Clean drinking water is not available to millions of people in developing countries.
available.zh: 发展中国家有数百万人无法获得清洁的饮用水。

avalanche.en: An avalanche buried the mountain road, forcing rescue teams to search for survivors.
avalanche.zh: 一场雪崩掩埋了山路，迫使救援队搜寻幸存者。

candidate.en: Each candidate for the scholarship must submit a research proposal and two reference letters.
candidate.zh: 每位奖学金申请人都必须提交一份研究计划和两封推荐信。

cathedral.en: The medieval cathedral took over two centuries to complete and remains a symbol of the city.
cathedral.zh: 这座中世纪大教堂花了两个多世纪才建成，至今仍是这座城市的象征。

celebrity.en: Social media has made it possible for ordinary people to achieve celebrity overnight.
celebrity.zh: 社交媒体使普通人有可能一夜成名。

celestial.en: Ancient astronomers carefully recorded the movements of celestial bodies such as planets and comets.
celestial.zh: 古代天文学家仔细记录了行星和彗星等天体的运动。

circulate.en: Blood circulates through the body, delivering oxygen and nutrients to every cell.
circulate.zh: 血液在体内循环，将氧气和营养物质输送到每一个细胞。

component.en: A reliable public transport system is a key component of any sustainable city.
component.zh: 可靠的公共交通系统是任何可持续城市的关键组成部分。

consensus.en: After long discussion, the committee reached a consensus on the new environmental policy.
consensus.zh: 经过长时间讨论，委员会就新的环境政策达成了共识。

continent.en: Africa is the second largest continent and contains a remarkable diversity of ecosystems.
continent.zh: 非洲是第二大洲，拥有极其多样的生态系统。

cultivate.en: Schools should cultivate students' curiosity and independent thinking rather than simply testing memory.
cultivate.zh: 学校应培养学生的好奇心和独立思考能力，而不仅仅是考查记忆力。

decompose.en: Bacteria and fungi decompose dead leaves, returning nutrients to the soil.
decompose.zh: 细菌和真菌分解枯叶，将营养物质归还给土壤。

desperate.en: Many rural families are desperate for access to clean water and basic medical care.
desperate.zh: 许多农村家庭急需获得清洁水和基本医疗服务。

dimension.en: The internet has added a new dimension to the way people communicate and share information.
dimension.zh: 互联网为人们交流和分享信息的方式增添了新的维度。

diversity.en: Protecting biological diversity is essential for maintaining healthy and resilient ecosystems.
diversity.zh: 保护生物多样性对于维持健康和富有韧性的生态系统至关重要。

eccentric.en: The professor was known for his eccentric habits, such as lecturing while walking around the room.
eccentric.zh: 这位教授以古怪的习惯著称，比如一边在教室里走来走去一边讲课。

eloquence.en: Her eloquence and confidence impressed the audience during the international debate competition.
eloquence.zh: 在国际辩论比赛中，她的雄辩和自信给观众留下了深刻印象。

embellish.en: Advertisements often embellish the benefits of products to attract more customers.
embellish.zh: 广告常常夸大产品的好处以吸引更多顾客。

embroider.en: The witness tended to embroider his story, adding dramatic details that later proved false.
embroider.zh: 这名证人倾向于对故事加以渲染，添加了后来被证明是虚假的戏剧性细节。

etiquette.en: Understanding local etiquette is important for anyone doing business in a foreign country.
etiquette.zh: 了解当地礼仪对任何在外国做生意的人都很重要。

evaporate.en: When the sun heats the lake, water evaporates and rises into the atmosphere.
evaporate.zh: 当太阳加热湖面时，水蒸发并升入大气层。

excursion.en: The school organised a one-day excursion to the science museum for the students.
excursion.zh: 学校为学生组织了一次到科学博物馆的一日游。

expertise.en: The project benefits from the technical expertise of engineers from several countries.
expertise.zh: 该项目受益于来自多个国家的工程师的技术专长。

exquisite.en: The museum displays exquisite porcelain vases that were made for the emperor's palace.
exquisite.zh: 博物馆展出了为皇帝宫殿制作的精美瓷瓶。

fascinate.en: The discovery of a lost city continues to fascinate archaeologists around the world.
fascinate.zh: 一座失落城市的发现继续令世界各地的考古学家着迷。

fluctuate.en: Food prices fluctuate according to seasonal changes in supply and demand.
fluctuate.zh: 食品价格根据供需的季节性变化而波动。

formation.en: The formation of coral reefs takes thousands of years and supports enormous marine biodiversity.
formation.zh: 珊瑚礁的形成需要数千年时间，并支撑着巨大的海洋生物多样性。

germinate.en: Seeds will only germinate when they have enough water, warmth and oxygen.
germinate.zh: 种子只有在拥有足够的水分、温度和氧气时才会发芽。

hurricane.en: The hurricane destroyed thousands of homes and left the coastal city without power for weeks.
hurricane.zh: 飓风摧毁了数千所房屋，使这座沿海城市数周断电。

improvise.en: When the power failed during the concert, the musicians improvised and played without microphones.
improvise.zh: 音乐会期间停电时，音乐家们即兴演奏，没有麦克风也照样表演。

institute.en: The research institute has published several studies on the effects of air pollution on children.
institute.zh: 该研究所发表了多项关于空气污染对儿童影响的研究。

intuitive.en: Good software design should be intuitive so that new users can learn it quickly.
intuitive.zh: 好的软件设计应当直观，以便新用户能快速上手。

inventory.en: The warehouse manager checks the inventory every month to ensure there are enough supplies.
inventory.zh: 仓库管理员每月检查库存，以确保物资充足。

mechanics.en: The mechanics of how earthquakes occur is still not fully understood by scientists.
mechanics.zh: 科学家仍未完全理解地震发生的力学机制。

mechanism.en: Scientists are studying the mechanism by which plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
mechanism.zh: 科学家正在研究植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳的机制。

negotiate.en: The two companies negotiated for months before finally signing the trade agreement.
negotiate.zh: 两家公司谈判了数月，最终才签署贸易协议。

nocturnal.en: Owls are nocturnal hunters that rely on excellent hearing and eyesight to find prey at night.
nocturnal.zh: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的猎手，依靠出色的听力和视力在夜间寻找猎物。

nostalgia.en: Many elderly people feel nostalgia for the simple village life they knew in their childhood.
nostalgia.zh: 许多老人对童年时期熟悉的简朴乡村生活怀有怀旧之情。

notorious.en: The city is notorious for its heavy traffic and poor air quality.
notorious.zh: 这座城市因交通拥堵和空气质量差而声名狼藉。

offspring.en: Some birds return to the same nesting site each year to raise their offspring.
offspring.zh: 有些鸟类每年都会回到同一筑巢地来养育后代。

orchestra.en: The orchestra performed a programme of classical and contemporary works at the festival.
orchestra.zh: 管弦乐团在音乐节上演奏了一套古典和当代作品。

peninsula.en: The narrow peninsula stretches into the sea and is famous for its sandy beaches.
peninsula.zh: 狭窄的半岛伸入大海，以沙滩而闻名。

perennial.en: Water shortage is a perennial problem in many arid regions of the world.
perennial.zh: 水资源短缺是世界上许多干旱地区长期存在的问题。

petroleum.en: Many countries are seeking alternatives to petroleum in order to reduce carbon emissions.
petroleum.zh: 许多国家正在寻找石油的替代品，以减少碳排放。

potential.en: Solar energy has enormous potential to meet the world's growing electricity needs.
potential.zh: 太阳能在满足世界日益增长的电力需求方面具有巨大潜力。

principal.en: The principal of the school announced that a new library would be built next year.
principal.zh: 校长宣布明年将新建一座图书馆。

principle.en: The principle of equal opportunity is central to the country's education policy.
principle.zh: 机会均等原则是该国教育政策的核心。

prototype.en: Engineers built a prototype of the electric car and tested it on the highway.
prototype.zh: 工程师制造了一辆电动汽车的原型，并在高速公路上进行了测试。

rectangle.en: The garden was designed as a rectangle divided into four equal sections.
rectangle.zh: 花园被设计成一个长方形，分成四个相等的部分。

remainder.en: After paying the deposit, the remainder of the fee must be paid before the course begins.
remainder.zh: 支付押金后，剩余的学费必须在课程开始前付清。

sensitive.en: Children's skin is more sensitive to sunlight, so they need extra protection in summer.
sensitive.zh: 儿童的皮肤对阳光更敏感，因此夏天需要额外防护。

spectator.en: Thousands of spectators gathered in the stadium to watch the opening ceremony.
spectator.zh: 数千名观众聚集在体育场观看开幕式。

speculate.en: Scientists can only speculate about how life first appeared on Earth.
speculate.zh: 科学家只能推测生命最初是如何在地球上出现的。

substance.en: The laboratory tests showed that the substance was harmless to humans.
substance.zh: 实验室检测表明这种物质对人体无害。

versatile.en: Bamboo is a versatile material that can be used for furniture, flooring and even clothing.
versatile.zh: 竹子是一种多用途材料，可用于家具、地板甚至服装。

aboriginal.en: Aboriginal communities have lived in Australia for tens of thousands of years.
aboriginal.zh: 原住民社区在澳大利亚生活了数万年。

accomplish.en: The team managed to accomplish all its goals within the short period of six months.
accomplish.zh: 该团队在短短六个月内成功实现了所有目标。

accumulate.en: Plastic waste continues to accumulate in the oceans, threatening marine life.
accumulate.zh: 塑料垃圾不断在海洋中累积，威胁着海洋生物。

anticipate.en: Economists anticipate that the demand for electric vehicles will rise sharply over the next decade.
anticipate.zh: 经济学家预计未来十年电动汽车的需求将大幅上升。

appreciate.en: Young learners gradually appreciate the value of hard work and persistence.
appreciate.zh: 年轻学习者逐渐意识到努力和坚持的价值。

artificial.en: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way doctors diagnose and treat diseases.
artificial.zh: 人工智能正在改变医生诊断和治疗疾病的方式。

commentary.en: The documentary includes expert commentary on the causes of the economic crisis.
commentary.zh: 这部纪录片包含专家对经济危机原因的评论。

comprehend.en: It is difficult for young children to comprehend abstract concepts such as time and space.
comprehend.zh: 幼儿很难理解时间和空间等抽象概念。

compulsory.en: In many countries, education is compulsory until the age of sixteen.
compulsory.zh: 在许多国家，教育在十六岁之前是义务性的。

consistent.en: The results of the experiment were consistent with earlier findings in the same field.
consistent.zh: 实验结果与该领域早期的发现相一致。

curriculum.en: The school has revised its curriculum to include more practical skills and fewer exams.
curriculum.zh: 学校修改了课程，增加了更多实用技能，减少了考试。

deliberate.en: The government took deliberate steps to reduce air pollution in major cities.
deliberate.zh: 政府采取了审慎的措施来减少大城市的空气污染。

discipline.en: Strict discipline in the classroom can sometimes discourage students from asking questions.
discipline.zh: 课堂上严格的纪律有时会打击学生提问的积极性。

elementary.en: Children learn elementary mathematics through games and everyday activities.
elementary.zh: 儿童通过游戏和日常活动学习基础数学。

extinction.en: Habitat loss is the main cause of species extinction in tropical regions.
extinction.zh: 栖息地丧失是热带地区物种灭绝的主要原因。

extinguish.en: Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the forest fire.
extinguish.zh: 消防员通宵工作以扑灭森林大火。

facilitate.en: Online platforms facilitate communication between students and teachers across different time zones.
facilitate.zh: 在线平台促进了不同时区学生与教师之间的交流。

functional.en: The new library is not only beautiful but also highly functional, with quiet study areas and computer rooms.
functional.zh: 新图书馆不仅美观，而且功能性强，设有安静的学习区和电脑室。

hemisphere.en: Climate patterns in the northern hemisphere differ markedly from those south of the equator.
hemisphere.zh: 北半球的气候模式与赤道以南的气候模式存在显著差异。

hypothesis.en: The researchers tested the hypothesis that sleep deprivation impairs memory consolidation in adolescents.
hypothesis.zh: 研究人员检验了睡眠不足会损害青少年记忆巩固这一假说。

illuminate.en: Recent studies illuminate how social media shapes the political attitudes of young voters.
illuminate.zh: 近期研究阐释了社交媒体如何塑造年轻选民的政治态度。

illustrate.en: The report uses case studies to illustrate how microfinance can reduce rural poverty.
illustrate.zh: 该报告用案例研究说明小额信贷如何能够减少农村贫困。

inhabitant.en: Most inhabitants of the coastal village rely on fishing for their daily income.
inhabitant.zh: 这个沿海村庄的大多数居民依靠捕鱼维持日常收入。

metabolism.en: Regular exercise can speed up metabolism and help the body burn calories more efficiently.
metabolism.zh: 经常锻炼可以加快新陈代谢，帮助身体更有效地燃烧卡路里。

microscope.en: Under a powerful microscope, the leaf surface reveals thousands of tiny pores called stomata.
microscope.zh: 在高倍显微镜下，叶片表面显现出数以千计的微小气孔。

paraphrase.en: Candidates who simply paraphrase the question rarely score well in the writing test.
paraphrase.zh: 只是简单改述题目的考生在写作考试中很少能取得好成绩。

prosperity.en: Long-term economic prosperity depends on investment in education and scientific research.
prosperity.zh: 长期的经济繁荣取决于对教育和科学研究的投资。

psychology.en: Understanding consumer psychology helps advertisers design more persuasive marketing campaigns.
psychology.zh: 了解消费者心理有助于广告商设计更具说服力的营销活动。

tournament.en: The international chess tournament attracted hundreds of competitors from over forty countries.
tournament.zh: 这场国际象棋锦标赛吸引了来自四十多个国家的数百名选手。

vulnerable.en: Elderly residents living alone are especially vulnerable to extreme heat during summer months.
vulnerable.zh: 独居的老年居民在夏季尤其容易受到极端高温的伤害。

archaeology.en: Modern archaeology relies on satellite imaging to locate buried settlements without excavation.
archaeology.zh: 现代考古学依靠卫星成像技术，无需发掘就能定位埋藏在地下的聚落。

circulation.en: The circulation of fake news online poses a serious threat to public trust in journalism.
circulation.zh: 虚假新闻在网络上的传播对公众对新闻业的信任构成严重威胁。

communicate.en: Scientists must learn to communicate complex findings clearly to policymakers and the general public.
communicate.zh: 科学家必须学会向决策者和公众清晰地传达复杂的研究发现。

contaminate.en: Industrial waste has contaminated the river, threatening the water supply of nearby towns.
contaminate.zh: 工业废料污染了这条河，威胁着附近城镇的供水。

counterfeit.en: Customs officers seized thousands of counterfeit medicines that could endanger patients' health.
counterfeit.zh: 海关官员查获了数千件可能危害患者健康的假冒药品。

demonstrate.en: The experiment clearly demonstrates that plants grow faster under blue light than red.
demonstrate.zh: 该实验清楚地证明，植物在蓝光下比在红光下生长得更快。

deteriorate.en: Air quality in the city has deteriorated sharply since the number of vehicles doubled.
deteriorate.zh: 自从车辆数量翻倍以来，该市的空气质量急剧恶化。

discernible.en: There was a discernible improvement in students' speaking skills after the exchange programme.
discernible.zh: 交换项目结束后，学生的口语能力有了可辨别的提高。

disseminate.en: Universities play a key role in disseminating scientific knowledge to the wider society.
disseminate.zh: 大学在向更广泛的社会传播科学知识方面发挥着关键作用。

exterminate.en: Pesticides were used to exterminate the insects that were destroying the cotton crop.
exterminate.zh: 人们使用杀虫剂来消灭那些正在毁坏棉花的昆虫。

fundamental.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental human right recognized by the United Nations.
fundamental.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是联合国承认的一项基本人权。

linguistics.en: Modern linguistics examines how language shapes the way people perceive the world.
linguistics.zh: 现代语言学考察语言如何塑造人们感知世界的方式。

magnificent.en: The ancient temple offers a magnificent view of the valley stretching to the horizon.
magnificent.zh: 这座古庙提供了俯瞰延伸至地平线的山谷的壮丽景色。

painstaking.en: Reconstructing the broken pottery required years of painstaking work by skilled conservators.
painstaking.zh: 修复这些破碎的陶器需要技艺精湛的修复人员多年极其细致的工作。

precipitate.en: Adding acid to the solution caused a white solid to precipitate at the bottom of the flask.
precipitate.zh: 向溶液中加酸使一种白色固体沉淀在烧瓶底部。

proliferate.en: Online learning platforms have proliferated rapidly since the pandemic forced schools to close.
proliferate.zh: 自疫情迫使学校关闭以来，在线学习平台迅速激增。

rudimentary.en: The villagers built a rudimentary bridge from logs to cross the stream during the rainy season.
rudimentary.zh: 村民们用原木搭建了一座简易的桥，以便在雨季过溪。

superficial.en: His knowledge of economics is superficial, so he struggles to explain deeper market trends.
superficial.zh: 他的经济学知识很肤浅，因此难以解释更深层的市场趋势。

terrestrial.en: Terrestrial animals evolved adaptations that allow them to survive with limited water.
terrestrial.zh: 陆生动物进化出了使它们能够在缺水条件下生存的适应能力。

transparent.en: The government promised to make the funding process more transparent to regain public trust.
transparent.zh: 政府承诺使拨款过程更加透明，以重新赢得公众信任。

considerable.en: The new policy has attracted considerable criticism from teachers and parents alike.
considerable.zh: 这项新政策招致了教师和家长相当多的批评。

prerequisite.en: Basic statistical knowledge is a prerequisite for enrolling in the advanced research methods course.
prerequisite.zh: 基础统计知识是选修高级研究方法课程的必备条件。

controversial.en: The decision to build a nuclear plant near the town remains highly controversial among residents.
controversial.zh: 在该镇附近建造核电站的决定在居民中仍然极具争议。

photosynthesis.en: Through photosynthesis, plants convert sunlight into chemical energy stored in glucose molecules.
photosynthesis.zh: 通过光合作用，植物将阳光转化为储存在葡萄糖分子中的化学能。

bow.en: In many Asian cultures, people bow to show respect when greeting an elder.
bow.zh: 在许多亚洲文化中，人们问候长辈时会鞠躬以示尊敬。

dye.en: Natural dyes extracted from plants were widely used to colour textiles before synthetic alternatives appeared.
dye.zh: 在合成替代品出现之前，从植物中提取的天然染料被广泛用于给纺织品染色。

fin.en: The shark's dorsal fin broke the surface of the water as it approached the boat.
fin.zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍在靠近船只时划破了水面。

gap.en: The growing gap between rich and poor has become a major social concern in many countries.
gap.zh: 日益扩大的贫富差距已成为许多国家的主要社会问题。

hay.en: Farmers stored the dried hay in the barn to feed their cattle throughout the winter.
hay.zh: 农民把干草储存在谷仓里，以便整个冬天喂养牛群。

lay.en: The female turtle returns to the same beach each year to lay her eggs in the sand.
lay.zh: 雌海龟每年都会回到同一片海滩，在沙中产卵。

mat.en: Visitors are asked to wipe their shoes on the mat before entering the museum.
mat.zh: 参观者被要求在进入博物馆前在地垫上擦净鞋子。

odd.en: It seemed odd that the office was completely empty during the busiest working hours.
odd.zh: 在最繁忙的工作时间办公室却空无一人，这似乎很奇怪。

pit.en: The abandoned coal pit has been transformed into a lake surrounded by walking trails.
pit.zh: 这个废弃的煤矿坑已被改造成一个湖泊，周围环绕着步道。

raw.en: Raw materials such as iron ore and timber are exported before being processed locally.
raw.zh: 铁矿石和木材等原材料在本地加工之前就被出口。

rim.en: A thin layer of frost had formed around the rim of the frozen lake.
rim.zh: 结冰的湖面边缘形成了一层薄薄的霜。

rot.en: Left in damp conditions, the wooden fence began to rot within a few years.
rot.zh: 由于处于潮湿的环境中，木栅栏在几年内就开始腐烂。

rub.en: Rubbing the surface too hard may damage the delicate paint on the antique vase.
rub.zh: 用力摩擦表面可能会损坏古董花瓶上精致的油漆。

rug.en: The hotel room was decorated with a colourful woollen rug and matching curtains.
rug.zh: 酒店客房装饰着一块色彩鲜艳的羊毛地毯和与之相配的窗帘。

sum.en: The company invested a large sum of money in developing renewable energy technology.
sum.zh: 该公司投入了一大笔钱用于开发可再生能源技术。

acid.en: Acid rain, caused mainly by industrial emissions, damages forests and erodes stone buildings.
acid.zh: 主要由工业排放造成的酸雨会毁坏森林并侵蚀石头建筑。

alga.en: A thick layer of green algae covered the surface of the polluted pond.
alga.zh: 一层厚厚的绿藻覆盖在被污染的池塘水面上。

atom.en: Every atom consists of a nucleus surrounded by one or more orbiting electrons.
atom.zh: 每个原子都由一个原子核和围绕它运动的一个或多个电子组成。

beak.en: The bird used its sharp beak to crack open the hard shell of the nut.
beak.zh: 这只鸟用锋利的喙啄开坚果坚硬的外壳。

bear.en: A brown bear was spotted near the campsite, forcing the hikers to retreat.
bear.zh: 在营地附近发现了一只棕熊，迫使徒步者撤退。

copy.en: The museum displayed an exact copy of the ancient statue, since the original was too fragile to move.
copy.zh: 博物馆展出了这尊古代雕像的精确复制品，因为原件太脆弱，无法移动。

crow.en: A black crow landed on the fence and watched the farmers working in the field.
crow.zh: 一只黑色的乌鸦落在栅栏上，看着田里干活的农民。

cube.en: The teacher asked students to calculate the volume of a cube with sides of five centimetres.
cube.zh: 老师让学生计算边长为五厘米的立方体的体积。

deem.en: The committee deemed the proposal too costly and rejected it without further discussion.
deem.zh: 委员会认为该提案成本过高，未经进一步讨论就否决了它。

dive.en: Scientists dive to great depths to study coral reefs that few people have ever seen.
dive.zh: 科学家潜入深海，研究鲜有人见过的珊瑚礁。

drag.en: Volunteers had to drag heavy equipment across the sand to reach the excavation site.
drag.zh: 志愿者们不得不把沉重的设备拖过沙地，才能到达发掘现场。

edge.en: Several rare species live along the edge of the forest, where habitats overlap.
edge.zh: 几种稀有物种生活在森林边缘，那里是不同栖息地交汇的地方。

flat.en: The landscape east of the river is mostly flat, making it ideal for large farms.
flat.zh: 河流以东的地形大多是平坦的，非常适合大型农场。

fuse.en: When two metal surfaces fuse under extreme heat, the joint becomes remarkably strong.
fuse.zh: 当两个金属表面在极端高温下熔合时，接头会变得非常牢固。

glue.en: The craftsman used a strong glue to attach the broken pieces of the ceramic bowl.
glue.zh: 工匠用强力胶水把陶瓷碗的碎片粘在一起。

gulf.en: Oil drilling in the gulf has raised concerns about its impact on marine ecosystems.
gulf.zh: 海湾的石油钻探引发了人们对其影响海洋生态系统的担忧。

herb.en: Traditional healers in the village use local herbs to treat common illnesses such as colds.
herb.zh: 村里的传统治疗师用当地草药治疗感冒等常见疾病。

lawn.en: The university maintains a large green lawn where students often study in warm weather.
lawn.zh: 这所大学维护着一大片绿色草坪，天气暖和时学生们常在那里学习。

lead.en: Old water pipes made of lead can release toxic metal into the drinking supply.
lead.zh: 由铅制成的旧水管会把有毒金属释放到饮用水中。

leap.en: The frog made a sudden leap from the lily pad into the murky water below.
leap.zh: 青蛙突然从睡莲叶上跳入下方浑浊的水中。

lens.en: The camera lens was damaged, so the photographs came out blurry and out of focus.
lens.zh: 相机镜头损坏了，所以照片拍出来模糊不清、没有对焦。

lime.en: Farmers spread lime on the acidic soil to raise its pH and improve crop yields.
lime.zh: 农民在酸性土壤上撒石灰以提高pH值并改善作物产量。

melt.en: Rising temperatures cause glaciers to melt faster than new snow can replace them.
melt.zh: 气温上升导致冰川融化的速度超过了新雪补充的速度。

mild.en: The region enjoys a mild climate, with warm summers and rarely freezing winters.
mild.zh: 该地区气候温和，夏季温暖，冬季很少结冰。

mine.en: The abandoned mine was sealed off after experts warned that its tunnels were unsafe.
mine.zh: 在专家警告其隧道不安全后，这座废弃的矿井被封闭了。

oral.en: The final exam consists of both a written paper and an oral presentation assessed by two teachers.
oral.zh: 期末考试包括一份笔试试卷和一场由两名教师评估的口头陈述。

pipe.en: A leak in the underground pipe wasted thousands of litres of water every day.
pipe.zh: 地下管道的一处泄漏每天浪费数千升水。

pole.en: Melting ice at the North Pole is a clear indicator of global climate change.
pole.zh: 北极冰层融化是全球气候变化的明显指标。

pump.en: Villagers use a hand pump to draw clean water from the well each morning.
pump.zh: 村民们每天早上用手泵从井里抽取干净的水。

quiz.en: The teacher gave a short quiz at the end of the lesson to check students' understanding.
quiz.zh: 老师在课末进行了一个小测验，以检查学生的理解情况。

rank.en: The university ranks among the top ten in the country for engineering research.
rank.zh: 这所大学在工程研究方面位列全国前十。

rear.en: The birds rear their young in nests built high in the branches of old trees.
rear.zh: 这些鸟在筑于老树高枝上的巢中抚养幼鸟。

reef.en: Rising sea temperatures have caused widespread bleaching of the coral reef.
reef.zh: 海水温度上升导致珊瑚礁大面积白化。

role.en: Parents play a crucial role in shaping their children's attitudes towards learning.
role.zh: 父母在塑造孩子对学习的态度方面起着至关重要的作用。

ruin.en: Heavy flooding ruined most of the crops, leaving farmers without income for the year.
ruin.zh: 严重的洪水毁坏了大部分庄稼，使农民一年没有了收入。

rust.en: The old bicycle had been left outside so long that its chain was covered in rust.
rust.zh: 这辆旧自行车被放在外面太久，链条上布满了锈。

seal.en: Scientists attached a tracking device to the seal before releasing it back into the ocean.
seal.zh: 科学家在把海豹放回大海之前，给它安装了一个追踪装置。

slip.en: She slipped on the wet floor and injured her ankle during the school sports day.
slip.zh: 学校运动会那天，她在湿滑的地板上滑倒，伤了脚踝。

swan.en: A pair of white swans glided gracefully across the surface of the quiet lake.
swan.zh: 一对白天鹅优雅地滑过平静的湖面。

tide.en: There is a growing tide of public opinion against the use of single-use plastics.
tide.zh: 反对使用一次性塑料制品的公众舆论日益高涨。

tube.en: The laboratory technician carefully heated the liquid in a glass tube over the flame.
tube.zh: 实验室技术员小心地在火焰上加热玻璃管中的液体。

alien.en: Some species introduced from abroad become invasive and threaten native plants and animals.
alien.zh: 一些从国外引入的物种会变成入侵物种，威胁本地动植物。

alloy.en: Bronze, an alloy of copper and tin, was widely used to make tools in ancient times.
alloy.zh: 青铜是铜和锡的合金，在古代被广泛用于制造工具。

angle.en: The photographer chose a low angle to make the ancient tower appear even taller.
angle.zh: 摄影师选择了低角度，使这座古塔显得更加高耸。

audio.en: The online course includes audio recordings so learners can practise listening anywhere.
audio.zh: 这门在线课程包含音频录音，学习者可以随时随地练习听力。

blend.en: The new campus design aims to blend modern architecture with traditional Chinese garden elements.
blend.zh: 新校园设计旨在将现代建筑与中国传统园林元素融合在一起。

bloom.en: In spring, the desert suddenly comes alive as cactus flowers bloom after the rare rains.
bloom.zh: 春天，罕见的降雨过后，仙人掌花盛开，沙漠突然焕发生机。

brass.en: The antique shop displayed a collection of brass lamps that had been polished to a golden shine.
brass.zh: 那家古董店陈列着一批被擦得金光闪闪的黄铜灯具。

cable.en: Engineers laid a new undersea cable to improve internet speed between the two continents.
cable.zh: 工程师铺设了一条新的海底电缆，以提高两个大洲之间的网速。

chart.en: The chart shows a steady rise in renewable energy use over the past decade.
chart.zh: 该图表显示过去十年可再生能源使用量稳步上升。

chill.en: A sudden chill in the air warned the hikers that winter was approaching fast.
chill.zh: 空气中突如其来的寒意提醒徒步者冬天正迅速临近。

cliff.en: The coastal cliff is slowly collapsing because waves have weakened its base.
cliff.zh: 这座海岸悬崖正慢慢崩塌，因为海浪削弱了它的底部。

comet.en: Astronomers tracked the comet as it passed close to Earth for the first time in centuries.
comet.zh: 天文学家追踪了这颗几百年来首次近距离掠过地球的彗星。

cover.en: The magazine cover featured a striking photo of melting glaciers in the Arctic.
cover.zh: 该杂志封面刊登了一张北极冰川融化的醒目照片。

crawl.en: Traffic slowed to a crawl as heavy snow covered the mountain highway.
crawl.zh: 大雪覆盖山路，车流慢得像爬行一般。

crude.en: The country exports crude oil but imports refined fuels for domestic use.
crude.zh: 该国出口原油，却进口成品油供国内使用。

curve.en: The graph's curve flattens after 2010, suggesting slower population growth.
curve.zh: 图表的曲线在2010年后趋于平缓，表明人口增长放缓。

decay.en: Food waste left in landfills will decay slowly and release harmful methane gas.
decay.zh: 留在垃圾填埋场的食物垃圾会缓慢腐烂并释放有害的甲烷气体。

dense.en: The dense rainforest canopy blocks most sunlight from reaching the forest floor.
dense.zh: 茂密的雨林树冠挡住了大部分阳光，使其无法到达林地地面。

drift.en: Plastic waste can drift across oceans for years before washing up on distant shores.
drift.zh: 塑料垃圾可能在海洋中漂流多年，才被冲上遥远的海岸。

erode.en: Rising sea levels are beginning to erode the beaches that support local tourism.
erode.zh: 海平面上升正开始侵蚀支撑当地旅游业的海滩。

essay.en: Students must submit a short essay analyzing the causes of urban air pollution.
essay.zh: 学生必须提交一篇分析城市空气污染成因的短文。

exist.en: Scientists believe simple life may exist beneath the icy surface of that distant moon.
exist.zh: 科学家认为，在那颗遥远卫星的冰层之下可能存在简单生命。

fauna.en: The national park protects a rich variety of fauna, including rare deer and eagles.
fauna.zh: 该国家公园保护着丰富多样的动物群，包括稀有的鹿和鹰。

fiber.en: Doctors recommend eating more fiber to improve digestion and prevent heart disease.
fiber.zh: 医生建议多摄入纤维以改善消化并预防心脏病。

float.en: Tiny plastic particles float on the ocean surface and are easily eaten by fish.
float.zh: 微小的塑料颗粒漂浮在海洋表面，很容易被鱼类吞食。

frame.en: The bicycle's lightweight frame is made from a strong but expensive metal alloy.
frame.zh: 这辆自行车的轻质车架由一种坚固但昂贵的金属合金制成。

frost.en: An early frost damaged much of the fruit harvest in the northern region.
frost.zh: 一场早霜损害了北部地区的大部分水果收成。

grand.en: The city unveiled a grand new library that cost millions of dollars to build.
grand.zh: 这座城市揭幕了一座耗资数百万美元建造的宏伟新图书馆。

graph.en: The graph clearly illustrates how household internet access grew between 2000 and 2020.
graph.zh: 该图表清楚地展示了2000年至2020年间家庭互联网接入的增长情况。

idiot.en: Calling a classmate an idiot online can seriously damage that person's confidence.
idiot.zh: 在网上叫同学白痴会严重损害那个人的自信心。

imply.en: The professor's silence on the issue seemed to imply that he disagreed with the plan.
imply.zh: 教授在这个问题上的沉默似乎暗示他不同意该计划。

jeans.en: Many offices now allow employees to wear jeans on Fridays to boost morale.
jeans.zh: 许多公司现在允许员工在周五穿牛仔裤，以提升士气。

label.en: Consumers should read the label carefully to check how much sugar a product contains.
label.zh: 消费者应仔细阅读标签，查看产品含糖量。

magma.en: The volcano erupted after magma rose through cracks in the Earth's crust.
magma.zh: 岩浆沿地壳裂缝上升后，这座火山喷发了。

major.en: Climate change is a major factor influencing migration patterns in many developing countries.
major.zh: 气候变化是影响许多发展中国家人口迁移模式的主要因素。

match.en: The charity will match every donation, so your contribution will have double the impact.
match.zh: 该慈善机构将等额匹配每一笔捐款，因此你的捐助将产生双倍影响。

minor.en: The report notes several minor errors but concludes that the research is basically sound.
minor.zh: 报告指出了几处小错误，但结论是这项研究基本可靠。

moist.en: Seeds need warm, moist soil in order to germinate within a few weeks.
moist.zh: 种子需要温暖湿润的土壤才能在几周内发芽。

moral.en: The novel raises a moral question about whether scientists should create artificial life.
moral.zh: 这部小说提出了一个道德问题：科学家是否应该创造人造生命。

mount.en: Public pressure continued to mount as more evidence of the scandal emerged.
mount.zh: 随着更多丑闻证据浮出水面，公众压力不断增大。

opera.en: The city's opera house attracts thousands of tourists every year with its stunning performances.
opera.zh: 这座城市的歌剧院以精彩的演出每年吸引成千上万的游客。

orbit.en: The satellite will remain in orbit for fifteen years before burning up in the atmosphere.
orbit.zh: 这颗卫星将在轨道上运行十五年，然后在大气层中烧毁。

oxide.en: Scientists found that iron oxide in the soil gives the desert its distinctive red color.
oxide.zh: 科学家发现土壤中的氧化铁使这片沙漠呈现独特的红色。

phase.en: The project's first phase focuses on building roads, while the second involves housing.
phase.zh: 该项目的第一阶段侧重于修路，第二阶段则涉及住房建设。

plate.en: Earthquakes occur when two tectonic plates suddenly slip past each other.
plate.zh: 当两个构造板块突然相互滑动时，就会发生地震。

prize.en: The young researcher won a prestigious prize for her work on clean water technology.
prize.zh: 这位年轻的研究人员因其在清洁水技术方面的工作而获得了一项著名奖项。

pupil.en: Each pupil in the class was given a tablet to use for online learning.
pupil.zh: 班上每个小学生都分到一台平板电脑用于在线学习。

quilt.en: She wrapped herself in a thick quilt to stay warm during the power outage.
quilt.zh: 停电期间，她裹上一条厚被子保暖。

radar.en: Air traffic controllers use radar to track planes and prevent dangerous collisions.
radar.zh: 空中交通管制员使用雷达追踪飞机并防止危险的碰撞。

range.en: The mountain range stretches for hundreds of kilometers along the border.
range.zh: 这条山脉沿边境绵延数百公里。

ratio.en: The student-to-teacher ratio in rural schools is often much higher than in cities.
ratio.zh: 农村学校的师生比通常远高于城市。

rough.en: The hikers followed a rough path through the forest to reach the remote village.
rough.zh: 徒步者沿着一条崎岖的小路穿过森林，到达那个偏远的村庄。

scent.en: The scent of freshly cut grass reminded him of his childhood in the countryside.
scent.zh: 新割草的气味让他想起在乡下的童年。

shade.en: The old oak tree provides welcome shade for students reading on the campus lawn.
shade.zh: 那棵老橡树为在校园草坪上阅读的学生提供了宜人的阴凉。

shift.en: There has been a gradual shift toward online shopping among older consumers.
shift.zh: 老年消费者中逐渐出现了转向网上购物的趋势。

shore.en: Volunteers cleaned up tons of plastic waste along the shore after the storm.
shore.zh: 风暴过后，志愿者清理了沿岸数吨塑料垃圾。

slide.en: House prices began to slide after the government raised interest rates.
slide.zh: 政府提高利率后，房价开始下滑。

slope.en: Farmers planted trees on the steep slope to prevent soil from washing away.
slope.zh: 农民在陡坡上种树，以防止土壤被冲走。
