volt.en: A single volt is defined as the potential difference that drives one ampere of current.
volt.zh: 一伏特被定义为驱动一安培电流的电位差。

wing.en: The injured eagle could not move its left wing and was taken to a wildlife center.
wing.zh: 那只受伤的雕无法活动左翼，被送往野生动物中心。

wolf.en: Conservationists argue that the return of the wolf helps balance the forest ecosystem.
wolf.zh: 环保人士认为狼的回归有助于平衡森林生态系统。

worm.en: The worm burrows through the soil, improving aeration and nutrient circulation for plants.
worm.zh: 蠕虫在土壤中钻洞，为植物改善通气和养分循环。

yoga.en: Many office workers practice yoga to relieve stress caused by long hours at desks.
yoga.zh: 许多上班族练习瑜伽以缓解长时间伏案带来的压力。

apply.en: Thousands of international students apply to overseas universities each admission cycle.
apply.zh: 每个招生季都有成千上万的国际学生申请海外大学。

await.en: Graduates await the results of their final examinations with considerable anxiety.
await.zh: 毕业生们怀着相当大的焦虑等待期末考试的结果。

award.en: She received a national award for her pioneering research on renewable energy storage.
award.zh: 她因在可再生能源储存方面的开创性研究获得了国家奖项。

basic.en: Access to clean water and sanitation should be a basic right for every citizen.
basic.zh: 获得清洁水和卫生设施应当是每个公民的基本权利。

beach.en: Plastic waste washed up on the beach poses a serious threat to coastal wildlife.
beach.zh: 冲上海滩的塑料垃圾对沿海野生动物构成严重威胁。

beast.en: Ancient myths often portray the beast as a symbol of humanity's untamed instincts.
beast.zh: 古代神话常把野兽描绘成人类未驯服本能的象征。

bible.en: The Bible has profoundly influenced Western literature, art, and moral philosophy.
bible.zh: 《圣经》深刻影响了西方文学、艺术和道德哲学。

broom.en: She swept the classroom floor with a broom before the students arrived.
broom.zh: 学生们到之前，她用扫帚打扫了教室地板。

bunch.en: He bought a bunch of flowers and a small gift for his mother's birthday.
bunch.zh: 他买了一束花和一份小礼物给母亲过生日。

camel.en: The camel can survive for days in the desert without drinking any water.
camel.zh: 骆驼可以在沙漠中数天不喝水而存活。

chess.en: Playing chess regularly is believed to improve children's concentration and logical thinking.
chess.zh: 人们认为经常下国际象棋能提高儿童的注意力和逻辑思维。

climb.en: Temperatures are expected to climb sharply as the heat wave moves across the region.
climb.zh: 随着热浪席卷该地区，预计气温将急剧攀升。

coast.en: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying communities along the eastern coast.
coast.zh: 海平面上升威胁着东部沿海的低洼社区。

count.en: Researchers carefully count the number of birds returning to the wetland each spring.
count.zh: 研究人员每年春天仔细统计返回湿地的鸟类数量。

crowd.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to protest against the new housing policy.
crowd.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上抗议新的住房政策。

cruel.en: Critics condemned the cruel treatment of animals in the testing laboratory.
cruel.zh: 批评者谴责了测试实验室中对动物的残忍对待。

diary.en: Keeping a diary helps students reflect on their daily experiences and improve writing skills.
diary.zh: 写日记有助于学生反思日常经历并提高写作能力。

drama.en: The school drama club performed a play about environmental protection last weekend.
drama.zh: 学校戏剧社上周末演出了一部关于环境保护的戏剧。

dress.en: Guests are expected to wear formal dress to the university's graduation ceremony.
dress.zh: 来宾应穿着正式服装参加大学的毕业典礼。

drown.en: Hundreds of seabirds drown each year after becoming entangled in discarded fishing nets.
drown.zh: 每年有数百只海鸟在被废弃渔网缠住后溺死。

eagle.en: The eagle soared high above the valley, scanning the ground for prey.
eagle.zh: 那只雕在山谷上空高高翱翔，扫视地面寻找猎物。

enrol.en: More adults are choosing to enrol in online courses to upgrade their professional skills.
enrol.zh: 越来越多的成年人选择报名参加在线课程以提升职业技能。

error.en: A single measurement error can significantly affect the outcome of the entire experiment.
error.zh: 一个测量误差就可能显著影响整个实验的结果。

feast.en: The harvest feast brings the whole village together to celebrate a successful season.
feast.zh: 丰收盛宴把整个村庄聚在一起，庆祝一个成功的季节。

fence.en: A wooden fence separates the farmland from the protected wildlife reserve.
fence.zh: 一道木栅栏将农田与受保护的野生动物保护区隔开。

field.en: Researchers spent months in the field observing how bees behave in natural habitats.
field.zh: 研究人员在野外花了数月时间观察蜜蜂在自然栖息地中的行为。

flash.en: A sudden flash of lightning lit up the sky just before the storm arrived.
flash.zh: 就在暴风雨来临前，一道突然的闪电照亮了天空。

fluid.en: The human body loses fluid rapidly in extreme heat, so athletes must drink water frequently during competition.
fluid.zh: 人体在极端高温下会迅速流失体液，因此运动员在比赛期间必须频繁喝水。

flute.en: Archaeologists discovered a bone flute dating back 40,000 years, suggesting early humans already enjoyed music.
flute.zh: 考古学家发现了一支距今四万年的骨笛，表明早期人类已经懂得欣赏音乐。

flyby.en: During its flyby of Jupiter, the spacecraft captured detailed images of the planet's turbulent atmosphere.
flyby.zh: 在飞掠木星期间，该航天器拍摄到了这颗行星动荡大气层的详细图像。

focus.en: Many education systems now focus on developing critical thinking rather than simply memorizing facts.
focus.zh: 许多教育体系现在侧重于培养批判性思维，而不是单纯地记忆事实。

fruit.en: The apple trees in the orchard usually fruit in early autumn, providing farmers with a rich harvest.
fruit.zh: 果园里的苹果树通常在初秋结果，为农民带来丰厚的收成。

gizmo.en: This tiny electronic gizmo can monitor your heart rate and sleep quality throughout the night.
gizmo.zh: 这个小小的电子装置可以整夜监测你的心率和睡眠质量。

globe.en: Climate change affects every corner of the globe, from polar ice caps to tropical rainforests.
globe.zh: 气候变化影响着地球的每一个角落，从极地冰盖到热带雨林。

glove.en: Workers handling hazardous chemicals must wear protective gloves to prevent skin damage.
glove.zh: 处理危险化学品的工人必须戴上防护手套，以防皮肤受损。

goose.en: A wild goose can migrate thousands of kilometers each year, navigating by the sun and stars.
goose.zh: 一只野鹅每年能迁徙数千公里，依靠太阳和星辰导航。

grade.en: Teachers spend hours grading essays, but fair and consistent assessment remains a challenging task.
grade.zh: 老师们花数小时批改论文，但公平而一致的评分仍是一项艰巨的任务。

grass.en: Overgrazing by livestock has destroyed much of the grass on this once fertile grassland.
grass.zh: 牲畜的过度放牧破坏了这片曾经肥沃的草原上的大部分牧草。

horse.en: Before railways were built, the horse was the fastest means of transporting goods across land.
horse.zh: 在铁路建成之前，马是陆地上运输货物最快捷的方式。

index.en: The consumer price index rose sharply last month, indicating growing pressure on household budgets.
index.zh: 上个月消费者物价指数大幅上升，表明家庭预算面临越来越大的压力。

jewel.en: The museum's collection includes a jewel-encrusted crown once worn by an ancient queen.
jewel.zh: 该博物馆的藏品中有一顶镶嵌宝石的王冠，曾为一位古代女王所佩戴。

knock.en: Scientists warn that a large asteroid could knock the Earth off its delicate ecological balance.
knock.zh: 科学家警告，一颗大型小行星可能打破地球微妙的生态平衡。

learn.en: Researchers learned that children who read regularly develop stronger language skills later in life.
learn.zh: 研究人员得知，经常阅读的儿童在日后的语言能力发展上更为出色。

local.en: The new policy aims to support local farmers by reducing taxes on agricultural produce.
local.zh: 这项新政策旨在通过降低农产品税收来扶持当地农民。

logic.en: The logic behind the argument is flawed, because it ignores several key economic factors.
logic.zh: 这一论证背后的逻辑存在缺陷，因为它忽略了几个关键的经济因素。

magic.en: For young children, watching a magic show can spark curiosity about science and illusion.
magic.zh: 对幼儿来说，观看魔术表演能激发他们对科学和幻觉的好奇心。

maths.en: Students who struggle with maths often benefit from practical examples linked to daily life.
maths.zh: 数学学习有困难的学生往往能从与日常生活相关的实际例子中受益。

metal.en: Recycling metal requires far less energy than extracting it from raw ore.
metal.zh: 回收金属所需的能源远少于从原矿石中提炼金属。

minus.en: Temperatures in the Arctic can drop to minus forty degrees, making survival extremely difficult.
minus.zh: 北极的气温可降至零下四十度，使生存变得极其困难。

model.en: Economists use computer models to predict how inflation might affect employment in the coming year.
model.zh: 经济学家利用计算机模型预测通货膨胀可能如何影响来年的就业。

mould.en: Excessive humidity in the building caused mould to grow on the walls of the classrooms.
mould.zh: 建筑物内湿度过高，导致教室墙壁上长了霉菌。

mouse.en: A wireless mouse allows users to control the computer from a comfortable distance.
mouse.zh: 无线鼠标使用户可以在舒适的距离上控制电脑。

movie.en: The documentary movie explores how technology is reshaping traditional forms of cultural expression.
movie.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了科技如何重塑传统文化表达形式。

nylon.en: Nylon is widely used in the textile industry because it is strong, light and quick-drying.
nylon.zh: 尼龙因其结实、轻便且速干而被广泛应用于纺织业。

ocean.en: Plastic waste dumped into the ocean poses a serious threat to marine ecosystems worldwide.
ocean.zh: 倾倒入海洋的塑料垃圾对全球海洋生态系统构成严重威胁。

olive.en: The olive tree has been cultivated in the Mediterranean region for thousands of years.
olive.zh: 橄榄树在地中海地区已被种植了数千年。

ounce.en: Even an ounce of prevention in public health can save governments enormous medical costs.
ounce.zh: 公共卫生领域哪怕一丁点的预防，也能为政府节省巨额医疗开支。

ozone.en: The ozone layer protects life on Earth by absorbing most of the sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.
ozone.zh: 臭氧层通过吸收太阳大部分有害的紫外线辐射来保护地球上的生命。

padal.en: Cyclists should pedal smoothly rather than push too hard on steep mountain roads.
padal.zh: 在陡峭的山路上，骑行者应平稳地踩踏板，而不是用力过猛。

panda.en: The giant panda's diet consists almost entirely of bamboo, which it must eat for many hours daily.
panda.zh: 大熊猫的食物几乎全是竹子，它每天必须花很多时间进食。

paper.en: The researcher published a paper on renewable energy that attracted considerable academic attention.
paper.zh: 这位研究员发表了一篇关于可再生能源的论文，引起了学术界的广泛关注。

phone.en: Many teenagers spend several hours each day on their phone, which worries some parents.
phone.zh: 许多青少年每天花好几个小时玩手机，这让一些家长感到担忧。

point.en: The main point of the lecture was that economic growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
point.zh: 这场讲座的要点是，经济增长不应以牺牲环境为代价。

print.en: Despite the rise of digital media, many readers still prefer the print version of newspapers.
print.zh: 尽管数字媒体兴起，许多读者仍然偏爱报纸的印刷版。

prove.en: Recent studies prove that regular exercise significantly reduces the risk of heart disease.
prove.zh: 近期研究证明，经常锻炼能显著降低患心脏病的风险。

queen.en: The queen delivered a speech emphasizing national unity during a time of economic uncertainty.
queen.zh: 女王发表讲话，强调在经济不确定时期国家团结的重要性。

reuse.en: Consumers are encouraged to reuse shopping bags to reduce plastic pollution in cities.
reuse.zh: 政府鼓励消费者重复使用购物袋，以减少城市中的塑料污染。

round.en: The government launched a new round of negotiations aimed at reducing carbon emissions.
round.zh: 政府启动了新一轮谈判，旨在减少碳排放。

royal.en: The royal family's public appearances often attract widespread media coverage and public interest.
royal.zh: 王室成员的公开露面往往吸引广泛的媒体报道和公众关注。

sandy.en: The sandy beaches along the coast attract millions of tourists every summer.
sandy.zh: 沿海的沙滩每年夏天吸引数百万游客。

scene.en: The police arrived at the scene within minutes, but the evidence had already been removed.
scene.zh: 警察几分钟内就赶到了现场，但证据已被移走。

shave.en: Some men shave every morning before work, while others prefer a beard.
shave.zh: 有些男士每天早晨上班前刮胡子，而另一些人则喜欢留胡须。

sheet.en: Please write your answers on a single sheet of paper and submit it before Friday.
sheet.zh: 请将答案写在一张纸上，并在周五之前提交。

shelf.en: The library shelves are organized by subject, making it easier for students to find references.
shelf.zh: 图书馆的书架按学科分类，使学生更容易找到参考资料。

skate.en: In winter, many families skate on frozen lakes and rivers in northern countries.
skate.zh: 冬季，北方国家的许多家庭会在结冰的湖泊和河流上滑冰。

skill.en: Employers increasingly value communication skills alongside technical knowledge when hiring graduates.
skill.zh: 雇主在招聘毕业生时越来越看重沟通技巧，而不仅仅是专业知识。

spade.en: Volunteers used a spade to dig holes and plant young trees along the riverbank.
spade.zh: 志愿者们用铲子挖坑，在河岸边种下小树。

stony.en: The stony path up the mountain made the hike exhausting, yet the panoramic view at the summit rewarded every step.
stony.zh: 上山那条多石的小路让徒步变得十分疲惫，然而登顶后的全景让每一步都值得。

stool.en: She pulled up a wooden stool and sat beside the laboratory bench, carefully recording the results of each trial.
stool.zh: 她拉过一张木凳，坐在实验台旁，仔细记录每一次试验的结果。

story.en: The documentary tells the story of a small fishing village struggling to survive as fish stocks decline.
story.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一个小渔村在鱼类资源减少的情况下艰难求生的故事。

straw.en: Many restaurants have replaced plastic straws with paper ones to reduce the amount of waste entering the ocean.
straw.zh: 许多餐厅已用纸吸管取代塑料吸管，以减少流入海洋的垃圾量。

study.en: A recent study found that students who sleep fewer than six hours perform worse on memory tests.
study.zh: 最近一项研究发现，睡眠不足六小时的学生在记忆测试中表现更差。

stuff.en: The attic was full of old stuff nobody needed, so the family decided to donate most of it.
stuff.zh: 阁楼里堆满了没人需要的旧东西，于是这家人决定把大部分捐出去。

style.en: Her writing style is clear and concise, which makes complex scientific ideas accessible to ordinary readers.
style.zh: 她的写作风格清晰简洁，使复杂的科学概念对普通读者来说也易于理解。

throw.en: Every year the city throws a huge festival to celebrate its cultural heritage and attract tourists.
throw.zh: 每年这座城市都会举办盛大的节庆来庆祝其文化遗产并吸引游客。

total.en: The total cost of the new railway project is expected to exceed ten billion dollars.
total.zh: 这个新铁路项目的总成本预计将超过一百亿美元。

towel.en: Hotel guests are encouraged to reuse their towels to conserve water and reduce energy consumption.
towel.zh: 酒店鼓励客人重复使用毛巾，以节约用水并减少能源消耗。

tribe.en: The indigenous tribe has lived in the rainforest for centuries, relying entirely on its natural resources.
tribe.zh: 这个原住民部落已在雨林中生活了几个世纪，完全依赖其自然资源。

tulip.en: Every spring, thousands of tourists visit the Netherlands to admire the tulip fields in full bloom.
tulip.zh: 每年春天，成千上万的游客前往荷兰欣赏盛开的郁金香花田。

usage.en: The rapid growth in internet usage has raised serious concerns about privacy and data security.
usage.zh: 互联网使用量的迅速增长引发了人们对隐私和数据安全的严重担忧。

vowel.en: Young children often confuse certain vowel sounds, which can make spelling and pronunciation difficult.
vowel.zh: 幼儿常常混淆某些元音发音，这会使拼写和发音变得困难。

weave.en: For generations, women in the village have woven baskets from bamboo and sold them at local markets.
weave.zh: 几代人以来，村里的妇女一直用竹子编织篮子，并在当地市场上出售。

wedge.en: A small wedge of cheese and a slice of bread were all he had for lunch that day.
wedge.zh: 一小块楔形奶酪和一片面包就是他那天午餐的全部。

whale.en: Conservation groups warn that ship strikes and plastic pollution threaten the survival of blue whales.
whale.zh: 保护组织警告说，船只撞击和塑料污染威胁着蓝鲸的生存。

width.en: The river varies in width from twenty metres in the mountains to nearly a kilometre near the sea.
width.zh: 这条河的宽度从山区的二十米到入海处近一公里不等。

wrong.en: It is wrong to assume that economic growth always leads to a better quality of life.
wrong.zh: 认为经济增长总能带来更高生活质量是错误的。

xerox.en: Please Xerox these documents and distribute one copy to each member of the committee.
xerox.zh: 请复印这些文件，并给委员会的每位成员分发一份。

zebra.en: The zebra's distinctive black-and-white stripes help confuse predators when the animals move in large herds.
zebra.zh: 斑马独特的黑白条纹有助于在成群移动时迷惑捕食者。

accent.en: Although she speaks fluent English, her strong accent sometimes makes it hard for listeners to understand her.
accent.zh: 尽管她能说流利的英语，但她浓重的口音有时让听者难以听懂。

adverb.en: In English, an adverb can modify a verb, an adjective, or even another adverb.
adverb.zh: 在英语中，副词可以修饰动词、形容词，甚至另一个副词。

affair.en: The corruption scandal became a national affair that dominated headlines for several months.
affair.zh: 这起腐败丑闻演变成一场全国性事件，占据了新闻头条好几个月。

alumni.en: The university invites its alumni to mentor current students and share their professional experience.
alumni.zh: 这所大学邀请校友指导在校学生并分享他们的职业经验。

artist.en: The artist spent three years painting a mural that depicts the history of the local community.
artist.zh: 这位艺术家花了三年时间绘制一幅描绘当地社区历史的壁画。

author.en: The author argues that technology has fundamentally changed the way young people form relationships.
author.zh: 作者认为科技从根本上改变了年轻人建立人际关系的方式。

ballet.en: She has studied ballet since childhood and now performs with a leading dance company in London.
ballet.zh: 她从小学习芭蕾舞，如今在伦敦一家顶尖舞蹈团演出。

belief.en: A common belief in many cultures is that education is the key to a better future.
belief.zh: 许多文化中一个普遍的信念是，教育是通往更美好未来的关键。

belong.en: These ancient manuscripts belong to the national library and cannot be taken out of the building.
belong.zh: 这些古代手稿属于国家图书馆，不能带出大楼。

binary.en: Computers process all information as binary code, using only the digits zero and one.
binary.zh: 计算机以二进制代码处理所有信息，只使用数字零和一。

bishop.en: The bishop delivered a powerful speech about compassion and social justice at the cathedral.
bishop.zh: 主教在大教堂里发表了一篇关于同情心和社会正义的有力演讲。

border.en: Thousands of refugees have crossed the border in search of safety and a better life.
border.zh: 成千上万的难民越过边境，寻求安全和更美好的生活。

branch.en: The bank plans to open a new branch in the city centre to serve more customers.
branch.zh: 这家银行计划在市中心开设一家新分行，以服务更多客户。

button.en: He pressed the red button on the machine, and the entire production line stopped immediately.
button.zh: 他按下机器上的红色按钮，整条生产线立刻停了下来。

camera.en: Security cameras installed in public spaces have helped reduce crime in many urban areas.
camera.zh: 安装在公共场所的监控摄像头帮助减少了许多城区的犯罪。

candle.en: Millions of people lit a candle to show their support for the victims of the earthquake.
candle.zh: 数百万人点燃蜡烛，表达对地震受灾者的支持。

carpet.en: The hotel lobby was covered with a thick red carpet that muffled the sound of footsteps.
carpet.zh: 酒店大堂铺着厚厚的红色地毯，减弱了脚步声。

cattle.en: Raising cattle for beef requires large amounts of land, water, and feed, contributing to deforestation.
cattle.zh: 饲养肉牛需要大量土地、水和饲料，助长了森林砍伐。

church.en: The old stone church in the village square has stood there for more than three centuries.
church.zh: 村广场上那座古老的石砌教堂已在那里矗立了三百多年。

circle.en: The students sat in a circle and took turns sharing their opinions on the topic.
circle.zh: 学生们围坐成一圈，轮流分享对这个话题的看法。

circus.en: As a child, she dreamed of joining the circus and performing acrobatics in front of a crowd.
circus.zh: 小时候，她梦想加入马戏团，在观众面前表演杂技。

clever.en: The clever design of the building uses natural light to reduce electricity consumption during the day.
clever.zh: 这座建筑巧妙的设计利用自然光来减少白天的电力消耗。

clothe.en: The charity collects donations to feed and clothe families who have lost their homes in the flood.
clothe.zh: 这家慈善机构募集捐款，为在洪水中失去家园的家庭提供食物和衣物。

compus.en: The new library is located at the centre of campus, making it easily accessible to all students.
compus.zh: 新图书馆位于校园中心，方便所有学生前往。

cotton.en: Cotton remains one of the most widely used natural fibres in the global textile industry.
cotton.zh: 棉花仍是全球纺织业中使用最广泛的天然纤维之一。

course.en: The university offers an online course on climate change that students can complete at their own pace.
course.zh: 这所大学开设了一门关于气候变化的在线课程，学生可以按自己的节奏完成。

cruise.en: The cruise ship carried more than three thousand passengers along the coast of the Mediterranean.
cruise.zh: 这艘游轮载着三千多名乘客沿着地中海海岸航行。

degree.en: She earned a master's degree in environmental science before joining a research institute.
degree.zh: 她在加入一家研究所之前获得了环境科学硕士学位。

detail.en: The report describes in detail how rising sea levels will affect coastal cities over the next century.
detail.zh: 该报告详细描述了未来一个世纪海平面上升将如何影响沿海城市。
